Director, HRBP, Retail - East

Location: Remote, can be based in any major city throughout the North and South East of the US and within an hour of a major airport
Job Family: Human Resources
Level: Director

About the Team

The Retail Human Resources team is responsible for building HR Business Partner capability and delivering strategic people support to Sephora’s Retail organization. This team leads, coaches, and develops HR Business Partners who partner with Retail Operations leaders to strengthen talent, leadership, culture, workforce effectiveness, and employee experience across a large, complex, multi-unit retail environment.

Position Overview

The Director, Retail Human Resources is a strategic leader responsible for elevating organizational performance through talent, leadership, culture, and workforce effectiveness. This role serves as the senior HR partner to Retail Operations and leads a team of HR Business Partners supporting a large, complex, multi-unit retail organization.

The Director plays a critical role in translating strategy into meaningful business outcomes while helping shape the future of the HR function. This leader combines strong business acumen, organizational insight, and leadership influence to solve complex challenges, strengthen leadership capability, and drive meaningful business and organizational outcomes.

The ideal candidate moves seamlessly between frontline realities and enterprise strategy, understanding the root causes behind business challenges while developing scalable solutions that improve performance, culture, and organizational health. They are equally comfortable listening and learning as they are challenging assumptions, influencing senior leaders, and driving meaningful change.

This leader is responsible for building trust, raising standards, developing future HR leaders, and fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership.

Key Responsibilities

HR Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach, develop, and inspire a team of HR Business Partners.
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for strategic business partnership, execution, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Build team capability in organizational effectiveness, talent strategy, workforce planning, data-driven decision making, and business acumen.
  • Develop future HR leaders through coaching, feedback, development planning, and stretch opportunities.
  • Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Drive consistency in HRBP practices, standards, and service delivery across supported geographies.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve insight generation, streamline HR processes, and scale consistent support for leaders and teams.

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic HR partner to Retail Operations leaders.
  • Develop and implement people strategies that drive business performance, talent outcomes, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement.
  • Partner with leaders to assess organizational health, identify workforce risks, and develop actionable solutions.
  • Balance immediate business needs with long-term talent and organizational priorities.
  • Influence key business decisions through data, workforce insights, business acumen, and sound judgment.
  • Support organizational changes and business initiatives while ensuring alignment with company priorities and values.

Culture & Employee Experience

  • Protect and strengthen Sephora’s culture by promoting leadership behaviors aligned with company values.
  • Partner with leaders to foster environments that support accountability, trust, inclusion, development, and performance.
  • Support organizational and change initiatives that enhance employee experience and business effectiveness.
  • Reinforce leadership expectations and team norms that contribute to a high-performing, customer-focused culture.
  • Continuously assess organizational health and recommend actions that improve engagement, retention, and effectiveness.

Leadership, Influence & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Provide candid coaching and feedback to leaders while maintaining strong partnerships and trust.
  • Influence decisions and drive alignment across multiple stakeholders without relying on positional authority.
  • Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
  • Demonstrate resilience, adaptability, and accountability during periods of change.
  • Exercise sound judgment and manage risk while balancing business needs and employee experience.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Establish credibility through business partnership, expertise, consistency, and results.
  • Collaborate effectively with Retail Operations, Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Labor Relations, Legal, Learning & Development, Finance, Technology, and Corporate partners.
  • Ensure alignment and consistency of HR practices, expectations, and execution across East and West HRBP teams.
  • Share best practices and drive standardized approaches that improve organizational effectiveness across regions.

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience supporting senior business leaders in a complex, multi-unit, or geographically dispersed organization.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, including leading, coaching, and developing HR professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience translating business priorities into people strategies that improve organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, workforce planning, talent outcomes, engagement, and retention.
  • Strong working knowledge of employee relations, employment law, compliance, talent management, organizational design, change management, and HR operating practices in a retail or multi-site environment.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field required.
  • Advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Certifications

  • SPHR, SHRM-SCP, or comparable senior HR certification preferred.

Competencies

  • Strategic Vision
  • Business Acumen
  • Organizational Effectiveness
  • Talent Strategy
  • Leadership Development
  • Workforce Planning
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Collaboration & Partnership
  • Influence & Executive Presence
  • Change Management
  • Employee Experience
  • Inclusive Leadership
  • Agility & Managing Ambiguity
  • Resilience
  • Results Orientation
  • Coaching & Talent Development

Working Conditions

  • Availability outside standard business hours may be required to support urgent employee relations, operational, or business needs.
  • Travel up to 25% for store visits, regional meetings, and corporate office needs.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Directly leads a team of HR Business Partners.
  • Responsible for coaching, performance management, succession planning, and capability development of the HRBP team.
  • Builds a high-performing and engaged HR organization that delivers strategic value to Retail Operations.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: VP, HRBP, Retail

This role is responsible for leading a team of HR Business Partners supporting Sephora’s Retail Operations organization across multiple geographies.

What You’ll Get:

The annual base salary range for this position is $150,705.00 - $201,000.00 The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job. Individuals employed in this position may also be eligible to earn bonuses. This job will be posted for a minimum of five days.

  • Caring Community. You’ll collaborate with teammates who are equally passionate about innovating and driving the industry forward – together, united in beauty.

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

The Reddit Consumer Engineering organization builds and scales the products that Redditors use directly to discover content, participate in communities, and connect with others. Sitting at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and core user journeys, Product Engineers in Consumer Engineering partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Frontend Engineers to build, experiment with, and scale features that power how hundreds of millions of users discover, join, navigate, and engage with Reddit.

This centralized role hires across several high-impact consumer teams, including:

  • Core Product & Feeds: Home Experience, Recommendations & Content Discovery, Content Contribution
  • Community & Presence: Reddit Pro, Youth Experience & Teen Safety, Creator Tools
  • Growth & Engagement: Authentication, Notifications, Social Sharing, SEO, Onboarding.
  • Monetization & Conversion: Paid User Acquisition, Conversion Funnel Optimization
  • Identity & Security: Account Management, Trust & Safety

What You’ll Do

  • Cross-Functional Product Architecture: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Data Science, and Client Engineers (iOS/Android/Web) to translate business and user needs into reliable, low-latency technical solutions.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the full software lifecycle for major product initiatives from technical design docs and API contracts to development, testing, rollout, and observability.
  • Metrics & Experimentation-Led Engineering: Design, build, and evaluate A/B experiments. Work with tools like BigQuery, HEX, or Firebase to analyze user behavior, conversion funnels, and retention loops to make data-backed engineering decisions.
  • API & System Performance: Build and maintain scalable APIs (GraphQL, REST, gRPC) and distributed backend services optimized for client consumption and consumer UI performance.
  • Technical Rigor & Modern Tooling: Establish engineering best practices, improve developer workflows, mentor teammates, and use modern, AI-integrated tools to ship high-quality products efficiently.

Who You Are

  • User-Centric Mindset: An advocate for the user with an intuitive feel for product usability, interaction design, social dynamics, and user growth loops. You care deeply about why a feature is being built and its impact on the end user.
  • Data-Informed & Hypothesis-Driven: Comfortable working alongside Data Scientists and PMs to design experiments, establish core performance metrics, and iterate quickly based on real-time feedback.
  • Technical Rigor at Scale: 5+ years of hands-on backend development experience building and operating large-scale distributed serving systems in high-concurrency environments.
  • Bias for Action: Self-directed, innovative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-paced product environments where balancing velocity with system reliability is essential.
  • Collaborative Communicator: Outstanding communication skills with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment in fully remote or hybrid team environments.

Technical Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software development experience in one or more front end focused programming languages; Javascript, Typescript, ES6
  • Experience with one or more front-end web frameworks such as LIT, Polymer, React, Vue, or Angular with experience with CSS
  • Experience with GraphQL, REST, HTTP, Thrift basics, and the ability to design and implement maintainable APIs is a plus.
  • Modern Workflows: Experience or interest in using AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development workflows.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

This role is US remote. You will need to sit in a state where we are registered to do business, which the recruiter will confirm with you early.

Why This Seat

Our publisher book is growing faster than the team can reach it, and this seat exists to close that gap. You will carry a margin number from the start, own your accounts end to end, and ramp in weeks rather than quarters.

Room to build, not inherit. Publishers are arriving faster than we can onboard them, so the accounts you grow are ones you shaped rather than ones handed to you finished.

Multiple verticals, not one. Insurance, personal finance, and our wider partner network. Most affiliate manager seats narrow over time until you are the person who does one thing. This one is built to broaden. You start where you are strongest and pick up the rest as you go.

Our own offers behind you. You are not selling inventory a publisher has already seen from four other networks. That changes how the conversation goes.

What You'll Bring

  • Four or more years managing publishers in affiliate. Direct publisher or partner management for an advertiser or a network.
  • A margin or revenue number you personally owned. You can name it, name where it started, and name what you changed.
  • A regulated vertical. Insurance, credit, lending, health, or personal finance, and the judgment that comes with working inside real constraints.
  • You treat a no as incomplete information. When an opportunity stalls on compliance, you find out precisely what blocked it, then work both sides reshaping the partner's assets, or making the case internally where the rule allows room. You don't abandon good opportunities and you don't wait for someone else to solve them.
  • Tracking platform fluency. You are comfortable in a performance platform and you can tell when the data is lying. We use Tune, with IntegriShield and Lashback on the compliance side. If you learned somewhere else, that is fine.
  • Proactive optimization. You read the reporting, you see where a partner could scale or optimize, and you act. Spotting it is not the skill. Doing something about it is.

Nice to Have

  • Depth of relationship in insurance specifically
  • More than one regulated vertical
  • Experience across both direct publisher relationships and network distribution

What You'll Own

  • Your publishers, end to end. The relationship, the opportunities, the scaling, the results.
  • The margin on your book. You will have a number. You will know where you are against it.
  • A book that stays diversified. If one partner going quiet takes half your margin with it, the book is built wrong. Managing that risk is part of the job, not something you do once it becomes urgent.
  • Compliance, before it becomes a problem. You monitor partner traffic actively and catch the issue while it is still small, then raise it with the partner directly.
  • The relationship itself. Not just answering when a partner writes. Keeping them warm, keeping them moving, keeping them glad they work with us.
  • What you learn, shared. We have a weekly session on what is working, and people flag things in between without being asked. That exchange is how this team gets better, and it only works if everyone puts in.

What Great Looks Like

  • In 90 days, you know our offers, our platform, and your partners. You have had your first real optimization conversation with a publisher and it moved a number.
  • In 6 months, you are running your book independently and pacing against your margin target, and you have started picking up the verticals you did not arrive with.
  • In 12 months, you have driven $500,000 in incremental margin, your book survives a partner going quiet, and someone else on the team is running a play you figured out.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

  • Want a book that is already built and a slow quarter to learn it
  • Treat compliance as a wall rather than a problem to solve internally and externally
  • Prefer to specialize narrowly and stay there
  • Margin at or below $200,000 in a single year. No direct affiliate publisher management.

Total Compensation

Base: $110,000 to $130,000, set by location and the depth of your affiliate experience

Bonus: performance incentive also based on your expertise and level that you come in

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

  • Track, monitor, and report on sampling performance and project costs to support gross profit improvement and timely delivery.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Senior Manager, Audit Manager Training leads the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of training and capability-building programs for audit managers and quality audit staff across CCV.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Manager, Audit Manager Training leads the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of training and capability-building programs for audit managers and quality audit staff across CCV. This leader owns the curriculum that prepares auditors and audit managers to apply audit guidelines accurately and consistently, including training on AI-supported review tools, human-in-the-loop workflows, and the judgment required to validate AI-assisted findings. The role partners closely with Quality Audit Operations, concept development, machine learning and strategic analytics, and client service teams to translate evolving audit guidelines, quality findings, and emerging AI capabilities into effective, measurable training that improves accuracy, consistency, and readiness across the audit workforce. Grounded in Cotiviti's values—Deeply Curious, People Obsessed, Make it Count, and Build it Better—the Senior Manager fosters a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement. This role is expected to move beyond delivering training sessions to proactively identify skill and knowledge gaps, close them through targeted learning interventions, and confirm sustained improvement in audit performance. The Senior Manager serves as a business partner to audit operations leadership while fostering alignment among key stakeholders across CCV operations, quality assurance, content development, and technology teams.

Responsibilities

Audit Training Program Ownership

  • Owns and matures the audit training curriculum, including onboarding, ongoing certification, and advanced training paths for auditors.
  • Designs, delivers, and evaluates training on audit guidelines, sampling methodology, and quality standards, ensuring content stays current as guidelines evolve.
  • Develops and maintains training on AI-supported audit workflows, including how to validate AI-generated findings, recognize accuracy drift or exceptions, and apply human-in-the-loop review controls.
  • Partners consultatively with quality audit operations, analytics, technology, and content teams to translate quality findings and root cause analysis into targeted training interventions.
  • Builds and executes training remediation plans for identified skill or knowledge gaps, including scope, timelines, measurable success criteria, and follow-up assessment.
  • Ensures new or updated audit guidelines and AI-supported workflow changes are supported by structured rollout training, job aids, and post-implementation reinforcement.
  • Champions innovation in learning delivery, including the responsible use of generative AI tools to personalize training, accelerate onboarding, and improve knowledge retention.
  • Establishes training effectiveness metrics (e.g., assessment scores, time-to-proficiency, post-training accuracy) and reports outcomes to audit operations leadership.
  • Communicates training performance, emerging skill gaps, and remediation progress clearly to senior leadership with appropriate urgency and action orientation.

Relationship Management

  • Maintains professional relationships across audit operations, quality assurance, and the broader audit enterprise. Identifies opportunities to expand training initiatives to create measurable value for internal teams and clients.
  • Communicates training opportunities and outcomes to Cotiviti leadership.
  • Establishes reporting and insights on training program performance using metrics that matter.

Productivity Management

  • Ensures that training delivery goals and certification timelines are consistently met or exceeded. Removes roadblocks to effective learning.
  • Monitors trainer and facilitator coverage, redistributing work as necessary to achieve set targets.
  • Promptly addresses and resolves issues impacting training delivery and completion rates.
  • Builds trust, respect, and engagement through communication and positive reinforcement to create a tradition of maintaining and exceeding internal expectations.
  • Strives to continuously Build Better.

Leadership

  • Provides People Obsessed leadership by communicating expectations and future goals. Motivates trainers and instructional staff using a combination of individual, team, and department recognition.
  • Responsible for the operationalization of new training programs and initiatives, executed in collaboration with internal stakeholders including but not limited to the CCV Operations and Quality Audit teams, content teams, and the Client Service team.
  • Works closely with the quality audit team to ensure training reinforces and aligns with current audit guidelines and quality standards.
  • Works closely with teams responsible for developing clinical, coding, and quality-related content to keep training materials accurate and current.
  • Facilitates execution of new training concept development and maintenance of existing training curricula within learning management tools, and provides program oversight.

Project Management

  • Manages expectations of internal stakeholders via clear communication with audit operations leadership and business unit leadership.
  • Grasps internal operational cycles and processes as well as their impact upon training delivery.
  • Understands project scope, schedule, and resources for training initiatives.
  • Anticipates disconnects and identifies solutions.
  • Maintains a Deeply Curious mindset to follow training initiatives through to results and document improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, coach, lead, and retain top-tier training talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that supports high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field required; Bachelor's degree with a training, instructional design, quality, or healthcare focus preferred — may also include education, organizational development, or a clinical/coding discipline.
  • 3+ years of technical leadership experience: people and projects, with prior experience in a training, learning and development, or quality audit role.
  • Preferred: Active Registered Nursing license.
  • Preferred: Active Coding Credential.
  • AI-native experience using generative AI applications such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar tools to design training content, improve workflow efficiency, communication, and decision support.
  • AI accuracy mindset: understanding of validation, exception review, quality drift, and human-in-the-loop controls, with the ability to translate these into effective training content and measurable accuracy improvement.
  • Instructional design skill: able to translate audit guidelines, quality findings, and workflow changes into clear, engaging, and measurable training curricula.
  • Consultative influence: uses data and business context to influence teams and drive adoption of training and process changes without creating defensiveness.
  • Proven experience influencing behavior, reinforcing expectations, and driving adoption of process, quality, or performance improvements across audit teams.
  • Remediation execution: builds practical training remediation plans with clear owners, milestones, measurable success criteria, and follow-through.
  • Executive communication: able to communicate training outcomes, skill gaps, and program performance in a concise, balanced, and leadership-ready manner.
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, Macros, VLOOKUPs, queries, advanced written formulas).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Desire and capacity to learn new concepts and software.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in a HIPAA-regulated environment.
  • Comfortable speaking in front of a group, with clients, and working with physician executives.
  • Professional with ability to properly handle confidential information.
  • Ability to work well independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor staff and enhance performance.
  • Skilled in root cause analysis, trend monitoring, and needs assessment to distinguish isolated skill gaps from systemic or client-impacting training needs.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with instructional design frameworks (e.g., ADDIE, Kirkpatrick evaluation model) or quality methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean, or CAPA) is a plus.
  • Experience developing or maintaining audit training programs, certification pathways, or learning management systems is a plus.
  • Knowledge of medical reimbursement/payment policies, audit review methodologies, and medical terminology is a plus.

Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.
  • Completing tasks independently.
  • Interpreting data.
  • Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
  • Maintaining focus.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
  • Learning new tasks and completing tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.
  • Remembering and adhering to processes and protocols.
  • Applying established protocols in a timely manner.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

Base compensation ranges from $122,000 to $147,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

We are seeking a senior finance professional with a strategic mindset who thrives in a dynamic, private equity-backed business environment. This person will serve as a trusted financial advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team, providing analytical rigor and strategic insight to drive the company's highest-priority growth initiatives. Spanning corporate strategy, M&A, pricing, R&D investment, and new product commercialization, this role sits at the intersection of finance and corporate strategy in a modern SaaS company. The candidate must be a highly motivated self-starter who can independently frame complex problems, develop actionable recommendations, and communicate with conviction to senior stakeholders.

Principal duties and responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary financial partner to the CEO on strategic initiatives, including market expansion, competitive positioning, and long-range planning

  • Develop comprehensive market sizing frameworks (TAM/SAM/SOM) and investment theses for new product introductions and R&D allocation decisions
  • Own pricing strategy analytics — building models that evaluate monetization options, price elasticity, packaging structures, and margin impact across the SaaS product portfolio
  • Construct and maintain dynamic financial models that support go-to-market decisions, including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), payback periods, and cohort analysis
  • Translate strategic investments into quantified financial outcomes, including IRR, NPV, and scenario-weighted return analyses for board and PE sponsor consumption
  • Play a key role in preparing annual budgets and monthly reforecasts across bookings, revenue, operating expense, and capital expenditure
  • Demonstrate a clear understanding of financial results, including detailed variance analysis to budget, prior forecast, and prior year; identify key business drivers
  • Participate in the compilation of monthly and quarterly reporting to the Board of Directors and PE sponsor
  • Present financial information and strategic recommendations to the CFO, CEO, and senior leadership, as well as PE ownership as needed
  • Provide insight on financial risks and opportunities toward the company's goals across multiple functional and business unit areas
  • Act as a financial liaison for business and functional leaders on cross-functional strategic projects
  • Gain and demonstrate a deep understanding of GHX's business model, products, competitive landscape, and industry dynamics

  • Deep understanding of SaaS business model economics — ARR, NRR, churn, LTV/CAC, Rule of 40, and unit economics

jobs.description:
Technical Support Analyst | APAC | Full-time | 2+ years of experience

Who We Are

Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. With a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere with a single integration.

Agnostic by design, Yuno offers connectivity to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, optimizing acceptance rates, reducing costs, and strengthening security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction on the network. Global brands run their payments on Yuno, including Arcos Dorados (McDonald's), NetEase Games, GoFundMe, inDrive, and Rappi. Banks, acquirers, PSPs, and wallets use Yuno to modernize their infrastructure without replacing core systems and to prepare for the next generation of commerce, including agentic payments.

About the role

We are hiring a Support & NOC Agent based in APAC to extend our follow-the-sun coverage and to serve our growing base of Mandarin-speaking merchants and payment providers in the region. You will be the first line of response for merchant issues and platform alerts during APAC hours: triaging tickets, monitoring production health, investigating payment failures, and escalating to Engineering with clear, well-documented context.

This is a hands-on, operations-first role. You will work with logs, traces, and payment data every day, and you will own the merchant relationship from the moment an issue lands until it is resolved.

What you will do

  • Own the support queue (Pylon) during APAC hours: respond to merchant tickets within SLA, investigate, and drive them to resolution.

  • Monitor production alerts and dashboards (Datadog) and act as the on-call NOC responder for the region. On-call is fully Slack-based; no phone paging.

  • Investigate payment issues end to end: declines, pending transactions, webhook failures, provider errors, and routing questions, using logs, traces, and internal data tools.

  • Communicate with Mandarin-speaking merchants and payment providers (China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, and the wider region) in their language, and document everything in English for the global team.

  • Escalate confirmed platform bugs to the Product and Engineering teams using our escalation template, with reproducible evidence and clear impact.

  • Advise merchants on provider configuration, testing, and best practices. Support recommends and guides; implementation and provider setup are owned by the KAM and Implementation teams.

  • Hand over open incidents cleanly to the next region at the end of your shift.

  • Contribute to runbooks, macros, and internal documentation so the team gets faster every week.

  • Spot recurring patterns across tickets and alerts and turn them into improvement proposals.

What we are looking for

Must have

  • Fluent Mandarin Chinese (spoken and written) is mandatory. You will handle merchant and provider conversations in Mandarin daily.

  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken). All internal communication and documentation is in English.

  • Based in the APAC region with the legal right to work there. Working hours are aligned to APAC business hours, with rotating on-call coverage.

  • 2+ years in technical support, NOC, or a similar operations role for a SaaS, fintech, or payments product.

  • Comfortable reading logs and API requests and responses (JSON, HTTP status codes, webhooks) and forming a hypothesis before escalating.

  • Strong written communication: you can explain a technical problem to a merchant clearly and summarize it for an engineer precisely.

  • Calm under pressure, structured, and able to prioritize when several things break at once.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payments: acquirers, PSPs, card schemes, 3DS, chargebacks, or alternative payment methods common in APAC (Alipay, WeChat Pay, GrabPay, PayNow, UnionPay, etc.).

  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, Kibana) and ticketing tools (Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom, Jira).

  • Basic SQL for data lookups.

  • Cantonese, Japanese, Korean, or other APAC languages.

  • Experience in a follow-the-sun or 24/7 support model.

How we work

  • Small, global Support & NOC team distributed across LATAM, Europe, and APAC. You will be our anchor in the region.

  • Slack-first culture. Alerts, escalations, and on-call all happen in Slack.

  • We measure ourselves on response time, resolution quality, and how much we reduce repeat issues.

  • You will have direct access to Engineering, Product, and Implementation teams. Escalations are welcome when they are well documented.

  • Availability to work Saturdays and/or Sundays since the goal is to cover the smissing shift and have a 24/7 support team.

What We Offer at Yuno

  • Competitive Compensation

  • Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!

  • Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

  • Work Equipment

  • Stock Options

  • Health Plan wherever you are.

  • Flexible Days Off

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleMillions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Millions of professionals rely on Wolters Kluwer to make critical decisions across healthcare, tax, legal, financial services, compliance and corporate performance. As AI reshapes professional work, our customers expect software that is more intelligent, integrated and effective. Meeting those expectations requires rethinking how products are discovered, built, launched, measured and improved.

This newly created role reflects Wolters Kluwer's commitment to transforming how products are built in the age of AI. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Product Strategy & Transformation, you will help lead that evolution from the Corporate Strategy Office. Working in a small enterprise team, you will partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to strengthen the Product System and improve customer value, business outcomes and speed of innovation. A key focus will be advancing the Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (Agentic PDLC), using AI across product development. You will combine deep product expertise with a hands-on transformation mindset to implement and scale change.

How You Will Work

This is a senior individual-contributor role, leading through expertise, coaching, facilitation and influence. You will embed with business-unit teams on high-priority lighthouse initiatives, apply modern product practices and AI-enabled workflows, and turn proven approaches into reusable tools and operating practices for broader adoption.

The role can be based remotely in any country where Wolters Kluwer has an office and will require travel of approximately 35% to work directly with teams and stakeholders.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with senior product, engineering, design and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities and connect product decisions to customer and business outcomes.
  • Define, pilot and scale Wolters Kluwer's Agentic PDLC and broader AI-enabled product development capabilities.
  • Lead lighthouse engagements across product strategy, discovery, experimentation, delivery, launch and measurement.
  • Embed with cross-functional teams to diagnose barriers, build trust and translate insight into practical change.
  • Coach product leaders and improve operating models, portfolio practices, governance and metrics.
  • Turn effective practices into repeatable tools, learning experiences and standards for enterprise adoption.
  • Establish success measures, demonstrate impact and use evidence to guide broader rollout.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on Product Management and/or Product Leadership experience in B2B software, SaaS or technology companies.
  • Ownership of strategy and outcomes for a substantial product, platform or portfolio, from customer discovery through delivery and measurement.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional product, engineering and design teams to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong product craft across discovery, strategy, experimentation, prioritization, roadmaps, launch and measurement.
  • Recent hands-on experience building AI-enabled or agentic products, transforming product development workflows through AI, or both.
  • Ability to enter unfamiliar contexts, diagnose root causes, build trust and translate insight into action.
  • Proven influence on product direction, operating models or organizational effectiveness beyond a single team, without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong analytical, communication, storytelling and facilitation skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity and align senior leaders.

Preferred Experience

  • Leading product transformation, operating-model change or organizational scaling initiatives.
  • Coaching product leaders and strengthening product management practices.
  • Working across multiple businesses, portfolios or complex matrixed organizations.
  • Scaling reusable capabilities such as playbooks, metrics, communities of practice or leadership-development programs.

What Makes Someone Successful

  • Customer obsessed and focused on solving meaningful professional problems.
  • Passionate about product craft and motivated by helping multiple teams become more effective.
  • Curious, adaptable and energized by ambiguity, with high ownership and a bias toward action.
  • Strong product judgment balanced with evidence-based decision-making.
  • Pragmatic and hands-on, able to challenge the status quo, build followership and move from strategy to implementation.

Why This Role Matters

This role is designed for accomplished product leaders who have successfully built products, led teams and delivered meaningful business outcomes and are ready to extend their impact beyond a single product, platform or portfolio. Rather than owning one roadmap, you will help shape how product strategy, discovery, delivery and AI-enabled product development are practiced across a global software company. Your influence will be reflected not only in individual initiatives, but in stronger teams, faster learning, better decision-making and improved outcomes for the millions of professionals who rely on Wolters Kluwer every day.

If you are motivated by helping define product excellence, shaping AI-native ways of working and influencing the future of product development at enterprise scale, this is a unique opportunity to leave a lasting imprint across an entire global portfolio.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Summary of the role:

As our RFx Specialist, you will own the global RFx response process for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, due diligence questionnaires, and security questionnaires across M-Files.

Competitive bids often represent some of our largest and most strategic new-business opportunities. This role provides a dedicated point of accountability for ensuring responses are timely, compliant, persuasive, accurate, and consistent across territories and time zones.

Using an AI-powered response platform, you will qualify incoming opportunities, develop and coordinate responses, and bring together expertise from Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, and Legal. You will also own and continuously improve a governed content library, helping ensure approved responses remain accurate, current, and reusable.

This is a highly collaborative but independently driven role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex, deadline-driven work and can balance speed, quality, sound judgment, and attention to detail in a global environment.

What you will be doing/Responsibilities and Duties:

RFx Strategy & Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, due diligence questionnaires, and security questionnaires from intake through submission and post-decision debrief, providing global coverage.
  • Apply a consistent qualification framework to incoming opportunities so efforts are focused where requirements, timelines, and solution fit support pursuing the opportunity.
  • Analyze solicitations and develop compliance matrices, response outlines, production schedules, and contributor timelines.
  • Develop compelling win themes, differentiators, and executive summaries that connect stated requirements to buyer outcomes rather than simply restating existing content.
  • Manage multiple deadline-driven submissions while maintaining a consistent global standard for quality, accuracy, and compliance.

AI-Enabled Response Management & Content Governance

  • Operate an AI-powered RFx response platform as a primary drafting engine, including prompt design, source grounding, and human verification and approval of AI-generated responses prior to submission.
  • Own, curate, and continuously improve a governed answer library and reusable content bank to ensure responses remain accurate, approved, current, and consistent across territories.
  • Establish structured review gates for compliance, technical accuracy, and overall response quality.
  • Review AI-generated content for potential issues including unverified claims, outdated information, generic language, or other inaccuracies.
  • Maintain strong version control, approval processes, documentation, and audit readiness across submissions.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Coordinate input from Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, Legal, and other subject matter experts, often within tight timelines.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination and accountability for response quality, contributor progress, approvals, and submission readiness.
  • Track contributor progress, proactively remove obstacles where possible, and escalate risks early when additional support is needed.
  • Document and codify successful RFx practices into a repeatable playbook that establishes a consistent quality standard across global territories.
  • Ensure RFx activities remain aligned with broader GTM Operations priorities and reporting.

Public Sector, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Support the growing volume and complexity of public sector and regulated-industry requirements, including security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance documentation.
  • Identify, qualify, and track relevant publicly posted solicitations to expand the pool of opportunities considered by the business.
  • Track and report submission volume, cycle time, outcomes, and recurring win/loss themes.
  • Facilitate post-decision debriefs and use lessons learned to continuously improve response content, positioning, qualification criteria, and processes.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience managing RFPs, RFIs, bids, proposals, or similar competitive response processes.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to draft proposal content, including reviewing, verifying, and approving AI-generated responses before submission.
  • Strong knowledge of RFx best practices, including compliance matrices, response outlines, win themes, and structured review gates.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills with the ability to tailor existing content to specific customer requirements and create clear, persuasive responses.
  • Advanced Microsoft Word skills, along with solid proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex, deadline-driven submissions simultaneously without sacrificing quality or attention to detail.
  • Experience working with Salesforce and reporting on activity, outcomes, or other relevant performance measures.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to obtain timely input from busy senior colleagues and subject matter experts.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across multiple teams and time zones.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information with discretion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing RFPs, bids, or proposals within B2B software or SaaS.
  • Familiarity with public sector bids and security frameworks or questionnaires such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, CAIQ, and SIG.
  • Eastern Time Zone location to support collaboration across our global teams.

Participation in our Recruitment Process:

  1. Initial Screening w/People & Culture Team Member
  2. Hiring Manager (Vice President, GTM Operations)
  3. Internal Team Member/Stakeholder(s)

*Completed Recruitment Process Time Investment for Applicant: ~Approx. 2.5hrs

Why M-Files?

Own Work That Directly Supports Growth

Competitive bids can represent some of M-Files’ largest and most strategic new-business opportunities. You’ll have meaningful ownership of how we evaluate, develop, coordinate, and deliver RFx responses globally while helping establish a consistent standard for quality and execution.

Put AI to Work

AI is an important part of how this role gets work done. You’ll use AI-powered technology throughout the response process while applying the human judgment necessary to ensure every submission remains accurate, relevant, compliant, and persuasive.

Work Across the Business

You’ll collaborate with teams across Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, Legal, and GTM Operations, giving you broad exposure to our business, technology, customers, and go-to-market strategy.

Build for Scale

Your impact will extend beyond individual submissions. You’ll help improve how M-Files approaches RFx work globally, from reusable content and governance to qualification, review processes, reporting, and continuous improvement.

A Culture Built on Trust

Our guiding principles, Make It Happen, Help Others, and Love Customers, shape how we work together every day. We value people who take ownership, collaborate across boundaries, use sound judgment, and continually look for better ways to get work done.

jobs.description:
Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles!

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Solutions Consultant to join our team at Caseware, a leading SaaS organization. As a Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for successfully leading our customers and prospective customers through exploration and evaluations of Caseware solutions. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, working collaboratively with accounting firms and organizations as they navigate critical decisions around technology modernization.

By taking a consultative approach, you will be their partner to guide them through all aspects of their software evaluation, helping them understand not only current solutions but also how emerging technologies, including AI and automation, can drive efficiency, enhance quality, and create new opportunities within their organizations. You will also liaise with team members in account management, training, professional services, support and product to help ensure customer needs are addressed on a timely basis, and professionally.

This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across North America and may require availability to accommodate meetings across Eastern Time (ET) to Pacific Time (PT) business hours, with notice, to effectively collaborate with clients, partners, and cross-functional teams.

❗This a full-time, permanent position

❗This a new vacancy

📍 Location:

The role is a remote role and is available to all applicants residing and eligible to work in Canada.

What you will be doing:

    • Partner with our Account Managers and other Solution Consultants in helping prospects and customers evaluate and plan to implement Caseware products, helping them understand how solutions can drive efficiency, enhance quality, and create new opportunities within their organizations.
    • Lead evaluation activities including presentations, trials & pilots, sharing information on solutions expertise and best practices with customers, while coordinating with technical or product SMEs where appropriate.
    • Strategize with customers on their migration & implementation journeys, from their existing accounting and audit tools, and work with them and the Professional Services team to ensure they have a clear direction and key requirements are addressed.
    • Support customer evaluations and implementations, providing information on tools, processes and resources to customers, and helping to ensure timelines and tasks remain on track.
    • Create and maintain product demonstration strategies, use cases and related assets that are value and benefit-driven, not feature walk throughs.
    • Act as the bridge between customers and Product teams, gathering and translating customer feedback into clear, actionable insights that inform product development while helping prospects understand how our roadmap addresses their business needs.
    • Attendance at Conferences and Events, maintaining relationships with customers and staying up to date with industry standards and trends.
    • Participate in speaking engagements and thought leadership events or publications, as comfortable.
    • Design and implementation of processes and systems to support the delivery of consistent, scalable services.  Assist in the development and execution of improvement plans internally that are scalable to support future growth.

What you will bring:

    Required:
    • At least 3 years experience preparing financial statements and/or performing Audit, Assurance, Review or Compilation engagements OR at least 3 years’ experience in customer-facing role (e.g., customer success, account management, implementation or project management) in a SAAS company serving the Accounting Profession.
    • Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills.
    • Effective communicator with ability to understand and interpret stakeholder needs.
    • Understanding of, or strong interest in, AI-powered accounting solutions and the ability to discuss how AI can be applied to modern accounting, audit, and advisory workflows with clients and prospects.
    • Strong organization skills with experience tracking and managing multiple deliverables and tasks.
    • A resourceful self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment where initiative and problem-solving skills are required.
    • Have a sound understanding of technology within the audit and accountancy sector, or an enthusiasm to learn.
    Preferred:
    • Have direct experience utilizing CaseWare to create financial statements or perform engagements.
    • CPA, Charted Accountant or equivalent, with 3+ years Audit or Accounting experience.
    • Experience leading technology adoption, training, methodology, or other innovation efforts in an accounting firm.
    • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field
    • Experience and/or qualifications in project, product or program management.
    • Practical experience utilizing AI tools, including for software development.
    • Deep understanding of accounting, financial processes and technologies.
    • Experience with CRM systems and tools for sales and lead management
    • Product, Product Marketing, Sales experience, or experience working closely with those functional teams
    • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software (E.g., Salesforce)
    • Experience documenting internal processes and identifying/implementing efficiency or quality improvements.

Salary Range

    The annual base salary for this position is between $110,000 CAD and $125,000 CAD per year.

    This role is also eligible for discretionary bonus and/or commission, as well as other benefits. Actual pay within the listed range will be determined based on factors such as transferable skills, relevant experience, market conditions, and primary work location. The posted range is subject to change and may be updated periodically.

What's in it for you:

▪️Innovation is at our core. We work with cutting-edge technology in accounting and financial reporting, constantly pushing the boundaries to create impactful software solutions.
▪️We are committed to a collaborative culture, where your ideas are valued, and knowledge sharing is encouraged within a supportive, inclusive team.
▪️Work-life balance is important to us. We offer flexible work options, remote opportunities, and generous time-off policies to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
▪️We offer competitive compensation, including a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits such as health insurance and retirement plans.
▪️We are driven by impactful work. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success.
▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us. We celebrate hard work through recognition programs, performance bonuses, and opportunities for career growth.
▪️We embrace global opportunities. Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team.

About Caseware:

Caseware's cutting-edge software products are meticulously designed for accounting firms, corporations, and governments. Our teams are continually collaborating, innovating, and building upon our existing suite of products. With a customer-focused mindset, we are building technology that is shaping what the future of audits, financial reporting, and financial data analytics will look like.
With a recent strategic investment from Hg Capital in 2020, Caseware is now in its next major growth phase as we double down on the people and products that have made Caseware so successful to date.
One of Caseware's core values is Many Voices, One Team and with that in mind, we're dedicated to building teams as diverse as our customers in an equitable and inclusive way. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Should you require accommodations or have any questions at any point during the application or interview process, please e-mail our People Operations team at .

AI Usage:

The recruitment process may use AI assisted tools but not for candidate screening or assessment. All final hiring decisions are made by humans to ensure fairness, transparency, and oversight.

Background Check:

Any candidates successful in obtaining an offer for a position will need to successfully complete a background check through Certn.co which typically includes an Identity Verification and Criminal Record Check. Executives and Senior Managers will undergo a Soft Credit Check as well. Candidates residing in the Netherlands and Germany are excluded from undergoing background checks via Certn.co

Security and Fraud:

Caseware takes the security of candidates seriously. All legitimate communication from us will come from email addresses ending in @caseware.com and our open positions are always listed on reputable job boards and on our website We will NEVER ask for payment or financial information from you. If you receive an unsolicited job offer, proceed with extreme caution.

jobs.description:
About Renaissance

When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.

UX Researcher II Job Description

Under general supervision, conduct research efforts and develop clear stories from insights that support partner and team alignment on user-focused goals. This includes collaborating with UX designers, product owners, product managers, and engineers to discover opportunities for future products and validate designs for product optimization.

In this role as a UX Researcher II, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, plan, and execute end-to-end research studies using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methodologies with guidance from senior team members
  • Conduct and synthesize research projects including user interviews, usability testing sessions, surveys, card sorting, and contribute to A/B testing initiatives
  • Synthesize research findings into clear, actionable insights and present recommendations to cross-functional teams with a compelling, influential story.
  • Analyze insights from research sessions to identify key opportunities and user needs
  • Works collaboratively and communicates effectively with peers and managers
  • Monitor and analyze user behavior metrics and usability benchmarks with support from senior researchers
  • Support the evaluation and optimization of research methodologies to improve quality and efficiency of insights
  • Assist with research operations including participant recruitment, scheduling, and research repository maintenance

Qualifications

For this role as a UX Researcher II, you should have:

  • Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, Social Science, Design Research, Psychology, Cognitive Science or related field
  • 3-5 years of experience in UX Research or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Proficiency in qualitative research methods including interviews, contextual inquiry and observational studies
  • Working knowledge of quantitative research methods including survey design and basic statistical analysis
  • Familiarity with mixed-methods research approaches
  • Experience with evaluative research including usability testing and heuristic evaluation
  • Exposure to generative and exploratory research techniques
  • Ability to execute research protocols and discussion guides
  • Experience with participant recruitment and screening
  • Understanding of research ethics and informed consent practices
  • Experience conducting research with diverse user groups

Bonus Points:

  • Portfolio showcasing research projects, methodologies applied, and measurable impact on product outcomes

Salary Range: The base range for this position is $82,200.00 - $113,100.00. This range is based on national market data and may vary by experience and location.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Benefits for eligible US employees include:

  • World Class Health Benefits: Medical, Prescription, Dental, Vision, Telehealth
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 401(k) and Roth 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Vacation and Sick Time Off
  • 12 Paid Holidays
  • Parental Leave (20 total weeks with 14 weeks paid) & Milk Stork program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Well-being and Employee Assistance Programs
Benefits listed apply to eligible U.S. employees in accordance with Renaissance’s benefits eligibility criteria. Contractor and other non‑employee roles are not eligible for Renaissance employee benefits.

At Renaissance, we encourage all applications. Roles evolve over time, especially with innovation, and you may be just the person we need for the future!

jobs.title: Patient Support Specialist
jobs.excerpt: PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company.
jobs.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team, fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture!
Site:

Job Description Summary:

The Patient Support Specialist at PTC supports rare disease patients (e.g., PKU) through focused case management for pediatric patients and their caregivers, as well as adult patients enrolled in PTC Cares. This role supports coordination of therapy initiation, managing patient-level logistical needs in collaboration with the Sales, Patient Engagement, and Case Manager teams, promoting long-term treatment adherence, and navigating life-stage transitions (e.g., childhood to adolescence, transition to adult care).

The Patient Support Specialist also serves as a PKU subject matter resource for the Patient Services team to promote consistent, high-quality patient support. This role does not provide medical advice but focuses on product training, adherence, and logistical responsibilities using approved materials.

The Patient Success Liaison supports adherence to relevant regulatory and compliance requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

.

Job Description:

Responsibilities:

  • Educate patients and caregivers on disease state, medication safety, administration and storage via phone/video and other approved channels.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Patient Engagement, and Case Manager teams with the assigned Case Manager, Patient Engagement and Sales to coordinate therapy initiation and ongoing patient support, align on patient-level logistical needs, and ensure a seamless experience for patients enrolled in PTC Cares.
  • Utilizes resources to empower patients and improve treatment compliance.
  • Identify and address adherence barriers (diet fatigue, taste preferences, social pressure, school/work constraints, access challenges, psychosocial factors).
  • Provide proactive follow-up based on program triggers, risk, missed check-ins, or patient-reported concerns.
  • Support transition milestones (e.g., increasing adolescent independence, transition to adult care teams, major life events that affect dietary adherence).
  • Coordinate with caregivers and healthcare providers, as appropriate and permitted, to reinforce plans and continuity of care.
  • Escalate urgent concerns, clinical red flags, or safety issues per program guidance and required reporting procedures.
  • Act as the PKU resource for Patient Services staff—answer questions, support complex cases, and provide coaching on patient communication approaches.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of PKU-specific workflows, scripts, and patient education tools.
  • Share themes and insights with leadership (e.g., common adherence barriers by age group) to improve services and patient experience.
  • Document all patient interactions accurately and in a timely manner in approved systems.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA/privacy requirements and PTC Cares program standards.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and support adherence/outcome tracking as defined by the program.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years of clinical nutrition/nursing and/or patient counseling experience with demonstrated adherence/behavior change support skills. Active, Dietitian/Nursing license and/or Master’s degree preferred.
  • Metabolic Dietician or Pediatric Dietician and/or nursing expertise with practical, real-world application across life stages.
  • Ability to drive sustained adherence through individualized coaching and barrier resolution.
  • High-quality documentation, organization, and follow-through.
  • Collaborative, consultative approach—trusted resource to the Patient Services team.
  • Experience with PKU and/or inherited metabolic disorders across pediatric and adult populations.
  • Strong competency in patient education, motivational interviewing, and coaching (including video/telephone delivery).
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact with patients, families, and HCPs.
  • High proficiency in handling patient logistics and tracking therapy adherence.
  • Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical delivery process and the ability to work compliantly/appropriately within the industry.
  • Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills, including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.

​Special knowledge or skills and/or licenses or certificates preferred.

  • Experience in rare disease patient services, hub services, specialty pharmacy, or patient support programs.
  • Familiarity with EMR/CRM documentation and metric-driven patient outreach.
  • Bilingual (as aligned with patient population needs).

Travel requirements: Up to 50%

Preferred candidate location: U.S. West Coast (Pacific Time Zone). Candidates in other locations will be considered; however, preference will be given to those based in the West Coast region.

Expected Base Salary Range:

$97,100 - $122,200. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.

In addition to base salary, PTC employees are also eligible for short- and long-term incentives. All eligible employees may also enroll in PTC’s medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings plans.

EEO Statement:

PTC Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.
