jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.

Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

  • Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)

  • Virtual pharmacist-led or clinician-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps

  • Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies

This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:

  • SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)

  • SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)

  • MTM (Medication Therapy Management)

  • TCC (Total Cost of Care)

  • Polypharmacy

During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.

As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission-driven, team-oriented, joyful culture.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns

  • Supports cost of care efforts by reaching out to providers and members to offer lower cost alternative medication options

  • Manages an assigned caseload which may require provider, pharmacy, and/or member follow-up to address medication recommendations, concerns, or questions

  • Independently oversees assigned cases and outreaches with timely follow-up, clear next steps, and thorough documentation

  • Helps members navigate their Devoted Health benefits

  • Participates in sprints, pilots, and special projects as they launch

  • Collaborates with the broader pharmacy team to support shared goals and coverage needs

  • Assists with training and shadowing when new team members join the team

  • Participates in team and pharmacy department activities and responsibilities

Required skills and experience:

  • At least 3 years of work experience in health care or retail pharmacy

  • Active National PTCB Certification

  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to members, providers, and pharmacies

  • Comfortable managing daily responsibilities and tasks independently

  • Ability to shift between tasks, projects, and priorities frequently

Desired skills and experience:

  • Highly organized and detail-driven

  • Comfortable learning new software and adapting as tools and workflows evolve

  • Adaptable and flexible, with a willingness to take on new or shifting tasks positively

  • A true team player who brings new ideas to the table, works through solutions with others, and lifts up their teammates

jobs.description:
About Advantmed

Advantmed is a healthcare services company headquartered in Irvine, California, serving primarily health plans that participate in government-sponsored programs. The Company operates three lines of business: medical record retrieval; medical record review and coding; and in-home health assessments. Together these support health plans across risk adjustment, HEDIS, quality reporting, and member care — with a substantial delivery organization in Ahmedabad, India supporting the U.S. operation.

In-home health assessments are the Company’s newest line of business and its fastest growing. Launched in 2017 and scaled significantly from 2024, the business today deploys a network of approximately 500 nurse practitioners and clinicians across roughly 32 states on behalf of 10 to 12 health-plan clients. Members are engaged through a combination of outbound telephony, text, direct mail, and a self-scheduling portal, and are seen in their homes by a clinician who completes a comprehensive assessment on the plan’s behalf.

In-home health assessment is where Advantmed sees its largest opportunity, and the Company has invested accordingly. Recent additions to the leadership team include a Chief Revenue Officer and a Senior Vice President of Client Success, both having previously served at Signify Health, and a Senior Vice President of Product Management with prior health-plan experience at SCAN. The Company is planning for in-home assessment volume to double, and potentially triple, over the next two years, and is actively investing in member-engagement and care-coordination capabilities to support that growth.

Advantmed was founded by Chief Executive Officer Akash Patel and Chief Operating Officer Jignesh (“Jig”) Patel who currently oversees operations across all three lines of business.

Position Summary

Advantmed is building a new healthcare offering focused on Care Coordination and Benefits Navigation and is seeking an experienced healthcare operator to build and lead the business from the ground up. This is a builder role, not a role overseeing an established operation: the mandate is to design the operating model, build the playbooks, stand up the technology and staffing infrastructure, hire and train the initial team, and take the offering from launch through execution.

Key Relationships

  • Reports to - Chief Operations Officer
  • Location - Remote within the United States
  • Team at launch - Building out Team

VP, Care Management & Navigation - Responsibilities & Strategic Goals

This is a zero-to-one build. The VP owns the design, launch, and scaling of the Care Coordination and Benefits Navigation offering — from operating model and workflows through staffing, technology, and performance measurement — and is accountable for taking it from concept to a functioning, measurable business.

  • Design the end-to-end operating model. Build member intake, assessment, segmentation, care planning, navigation, referral, follow-up, and case-closure workflows from a blank page, scoped to Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and D-SNP populations.
  • Build the operating infrastructure. Author the playbooks, SOPs, scripts, decision trees, and clinical and non-clinical escalation protocols the team will run on.
  • Stand up staffing and capacity. Define care coordinator and navigator staffing, caseload, and capacity models, and hire and train the initial team against them.
  • Establish performance infrastructure from day one. Build training, certification, quality assurance, and performance management programs, along with the KPIs and outcomes measurement the business will be run on.
  • Define the technology footprint. Set the case management and technology requirements needed to run the operation, including any build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Own member engagement. Design the outreach and engagement strategies that drive participation in navigation and care coordination services.
  • Take the offering to launch and scale. Sequence the build so the business moves from concept to live operation, then scales staffing, process, and technology against real client volume — with client reporting and unit economics in place from the start.

Requirements

Essential Qualifications

  • 10+ years of healthcare operations experience, including direct ownership of care coordination, care management, member navigation, or population health programs.
  • Strong working knowledge of Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and/or D-SNP populations and the health-plan operating environment they sit within.
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly scaling a healthcare service operation — not solely managing an operation someone else designed.
  • Track record developing workflows, SOPs, staffing and capacity models, training and certification programs, quality assurance, and performance metrics from a limited or non-existent starting point.
  • Strong understanding of member engagement and outreach in a health-plan or care-coordination context.
  • Comfortable moving fluidly between strategy and hands-on execution — this role will not have a large team to delegate to at launch.
  • A genuine builder mindset: energized by creating something from a blank page rather than optimizing an existing operation.

Benefits

Compensation

jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

As a Product Manager on our Wealth Products & Solutions team, you will help build and evolve Empower’s new native digital brokerage experience, creating an engaging investing destination that helps customers understand their investments, monitor their progress, and take action with confidence.

You will help shape experiences across the brokerage journey, from how customers understand their portfolio, positions, performance, balances, and activity to how they discover investment opportunities, trade, and engage with their investments over time. Your focus will be on turning complex brokerage information and capabilities into experiences that are intuitive, useful, and compelling for investors.

Importantly, Empower’s brokerage experience will serve customers across both our personal wealth and workplace retirement businesses. You will help evolve our native brokerage capabilities for retail investors while also supporting experiences such as Self-Directed Brokerage Accounts (SDBAs) offered through employer-sponsored retirement plans. You will consider how the needs, expectations, and journeys of these customers differ, and where a common brokerage platform and experience can better serve both.

You will join an ambitious product team building the next generation of investing experiences at Empower. You will bring strong customer focus, analytical thinking, product judgment, and a collaborative approach to working with design, engineering, research, business, operations, and other partners.

What You Will Do

  • Help build and continuously improve Empower’s native digital brokerage experience, with a focus on creating intuitive and engaging experiences that customers return to as they manage their investments.

  • Own and support customer journeys and features across key brokerage experiences, including understanding and reviewing positions and account details, searching for and researching securities, placing trades and tracking orders.

  • Identify opportunities to increase brokerage adoption, engagement, and ongoing customer value, using customer behavior and feedback to understand where we can make the investing experience more useful.

  • Help evolve Empower’s brokerage capabilities to support multiple customer contexts, including direct-to-consumer brokerage and Self-Directed Brokerage Accounts within employer-sponsored retirement plans.

  • Partner closely with design to simplify complex financial information and create clear information architecture, navigation, interaction patterns, and visual presentation across brokerage experiences.

  • Use customer research, usability testing, behavioral data, experimentation, competitive research, and market insights to identify customer needs, friction points, and opportunities.

  • Translate customer, business, and technical needs into clear product requirements and priorities in partnership with engineering, design, research, operations, and other teams.

  • Contribute to product strategy and roadmap development by identifying opportunities and helping prioritize investments based on customer value, business impact, data, and feasibility.

  • Partner across Empower to connect brokerage experiences with customers' broader financial lives, including retirement, investing, financial planning, and other Empower experiences.

  • Define and track measures of success across adoption, engagement, usability, customer satisfaction, and digital behavior, using results to inform ongoing product optimization.

  • Use quantitative and qualitative insights, experimentation, and agile validation methods to test hypotheses and inform product decisions.

  • Navigate initiatives through the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements, prioritization, development, compliance and legal review, launch, measurement, and post-launch optimization.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years of product management or directly relevant digital product experience working with engineering, design, research, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Experience building or supporting consumer-facing digital products, preferably within financial services, fintech, investing, retirement, or another complex digital product environment.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex financial information, capabilities, and customer needs into experiences that feel simple and intuitive.

  • A strong interest in customer engagement and behavior, with experience identifying opportunities to improve adoption, usage, retention, or other measures of customer value.

  • Experience defining product requirements and partnering closely with design on customer journeys, interaction design, information architecture, navigation, and information presentation.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using quantitative and qualitative data to identify insights, prioritize opportunities, and evaluate product performance.

  • Strong prioritization and stakeholder-management skills, including experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and organizational skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive product initiatives, collaborate effectively, and deliver results in a cross-functional environment.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience building digital brokerage, investing, trading, or portfolio experiences for consumers.

  • Track record of developing experiences across brokerage journeys such as account opening and funding, portfolio views, positions and holdings, performance, trading, transaction activity, or investment discovery.

  • Experience designing products that drive digital engagement, helping customers better understand their financial position and identify relevant actions they can take.

  • Experience with Self-Directed Brokerage Accounts (SDBAs) or other brokerage capabilities offered through employer-sponsored retirement plans.

  • Understanding of the differences between retail brokerage customers and retirement plan participants, including how brokerage experiences may need to adapt to different customer contexts.

  • Experience working with brokerage infrastructure, clearing or custody providers, including Pershing.

  • Experience connecting investing experiences with a broader financial ecosystem, such as retirement, financial planning, advice, banking, or wealth management.

  • Familiarity with Stock Plan Services or equity compensation experiences and how workplace equity can connect customers to broader brokerage and investing relationships.

  • Experience operating within regulated financial services and partnering with legal, compliance, risk, or operations teams.

  • Experience taking products through the full lifecycle from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, and optimization.

jobs.description:
Role Description

As Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing, you will lead the development and execution of Dropbox’s regional marketing strategy across the entire Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will bring the greatest depth of focus to Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets—Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Korea, India, and Japan—while building fit-for-market programs for Tier 2 markets including Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work in close partnership with the Regional VP of Sales to translate business priorities into integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that create pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and support regional sales growth.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of field marketing, channel marketing, sales, and Dropbox’s global marketing organization. Field and channel marketing will be equally important as Dropbox evolves toward a hybrid go-to-market model in ANZ and adapts its approach across APJ. You will build the regional marketing plan, manage the regional budget, and measure performance against clear business outcomes. You will also manage and develop our Japan Marketing team, ensuring our regional approach combines consistent strategy and operating discipline with strong local-market relevance.
You will be Dropbox Marketing’s senior voice in the region—bringing APJ customer, partner, and market insights into global planning while adapting global campaigns for local audiences. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded leader who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy, people leadership, and hands-on campaign execution.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the integrated field and channel marketing strategy for APJ, aligned with regional sales priorities and Dropbox’s global marketing strategy.
  • Partner closely with the Regional VP of Sales and sales leadership to develop regional and country-level plans that create qualified pipeline, accelerate priority opportunities, and support revenue growth.
  • Lead the planning and execution of regional marketing programs across field events, executive experiences, account-based initiatives, integrated campaigns, partner and channel activations, webinars, and other locally relevant tactics.
  • Build an equally strong field and channel marketing motion, balancing direct-to-customer and partner-led investments by market using customer insight, sales priorities, partner opportunity, and performance data.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Japan Marketing team by establishing clear goals, operating rhythms, and opportunities for growth while enabling strong local execution.
  • Build strong relationships with regional sales, partner sales, and channel leaders; create joint plans with priority partners and develop co-marketing programs that extend Dropbox’s market reach and generate partner-sourced or partner-influenced demand.
  • Translate global campaigns, positioning, and content into regionally relevant programs, partnering with global Campaigns, Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Communications, Marketing Operations, and other teams.
  • Own the regional marketing budget, agency and vendor relationships, program calendar, forecasting, and performance reporting; continuously optimize investments based on pipeline impact and ROI.
  • Establish clear KPIs and operating cadences with Sales and Marketing Operations, including regular planning sessions and business reviews that connect marketing activity to pipeline creation and opportunity progression.
  • Represent APJ within the global marketing organization, sharing market intelligence, customer and partner feedback, competitive insight, and regional best practices to improve company-wide strategy and execution.
  • Build a scalable regional marketing playbook that balances consistency across APJ with the distinct needs, cultures, routes to market, and buying behaviors of individual countries.
  • Travel within the region and internationally as needed to support team leadership, sales planning, partner engagement, and key programs—approximately 20%

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant experience in regional, field, demand generation, and/or channel marketing within enterprise software, SaaS, or another technology environment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing multi-country APJ marketing strategies that produced measurable pipeline and sales impact.
  • People-management experience, including coaching and developing marketers working across different countries, cultures, or time zones.
  • Proven ability to operate as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, translate sales priorities into marketing plans, and build alignment through planning and business reviews.
  • Experience leading an integrated mix of field and channel programs, including events, account-based programs, partner co-marketing, campaigns, and pipeline-acceleration initiatives.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills, including experience managing regional budgets, setting program KPIs, evaluating pipeline contribution, and using performance data to optimize investment.
  • Excellent executive communication, cross-functional leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a global, distributed, and highly collaborative organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep familiarity with the APJ technology market, with experience developing differentiated strategies across mature and emerging markets; direct experience in several of Dropbox’s Tier 1 markets is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a channel-led or partner-influenced go-to-market model, including co-marketing with resellers, distributors, alliances, or technology partners.
  • Experience building or evolving a regional marketing function, operating model, or playbook in a growing or changing business.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise and commercial buying journeys, account-based marketing, opportunity acceleration, and regional event strategy.
  • Experience working in a Virtual First or similarly distributed global organization.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make

In this role, you will help define how online programs managed by Risepoint's university partners get discovered, referenced, and recommended as AI becomes the primary gateway through which prospective students explore their options. You will build and oversee a network of vendor relationships spanning outreach, link development, and content placement, setting clear expectations for each engagement and holding vendors accountable to measurable citation and mention outcomes.

A core part of your work will be mapping the terrain: determining which publications, directories, and third-party sites get referenced when AI tools answer higher-education questions, then converting that intelligence into a clear roadmap for where relationship-building efforts should go next. From there, you will shape how Risepoint invests across that landscape, deciding which external partners are best positioned to open which doors and adjusting that investment as new data comes in about what's working.

Beyond day-to-day execution, you will help shape how Risepoint thinks about this space more broadly. You will contribute your expertise to a cross-functional group focused on measuring AI citation performance, evaluating new partners and tools, and testing new approaches to earning visibility. Your work will help Risepoint move early and deliberately in a discovery landscape that is still being defined, building habits and judgment that will only grow more valuable as AI-driven search continues to reshape how students find their program.

What You Will Do

  • Vendor Management – Build and manage a portfolio of vendor relationships spanning outreach, link development, and content placement — scoping work, tracking deliverables, and managing budgets and accounts
  • AI Citation Research & Target Identification – Identify the publications, ranking sites, and aggregators that AI engines actively cite for higher-education queries, and develop a prioritized target list for outreach and relationship development
  • Digital PR – Conduct ongoing outreach to editors, journalists, and webmasters at target publications, building the relationships needed to produce a regular and growing stream of earned mentions, citations, and coverage for Risepoint’s university partners
  • Outreach & Citation Strategy – Own the offsite citation strategy for Risepoint’s university partners that maximizes enrollment growth and citation ROI by adjusting investment based on citation performance, partner priorities, and program-level business goals.
  • AI Visibility Reporting & Intelligence – Monitor AI engine responses using visibility tools and direct prompt testing, translating findings into actionable strategies and reports for executive audiences
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner cross-functionally with Risepoint's SEO/AEO, Content, Brand Strategy, and Integrated Marketing teams to align outreach strategy with marketing initiatives and pilots already in flight

What Success Looks Like

  • AI citation has become a durable, defensible growth channel for Risepoint's partners that compounds year over year
  • Vendors function as accountable strategic partners rather than vendors-in-name-only, with underperformers renegotiated or replaced based on demonstrated outcomes
  • Risepoint holds a proprietary, living map of where higher-education AI citations originate, giving the organization a lasting information edge over competitors

Job Summary

This role is VA’s point of contact with the outside organizations that write and ballot health data standards. That means sitting in HL7, SNOMED, LOINC and similar workgroups, carrying VA’s position into those discussions, and bringing back what changed and what it actually means for VHA systems and workflows. The other half of the job is knowledge management. Standards work generates a lot of material, implementation guides, mappings, decision records, meeting notes, and most programs lose track of it. This person keeps that content organized, current, and easy for the team to find so the program is not rebuilding the same answer every few months.

Primary Responsibilities

Standards Development Organization Engagement

  • Represents VHA in standards development organizations and related bodies, including HL7, SNOMED International, Regenstrief/LOINC, NCPDP, X12, DICOM, IHE, and ISO/TC 215, along with federal standards forums and cross-agency workgroups.
  • Tracks ballot cycles, comment periods, workgroup calendars, and implementation guide development across multiple organizations at once.
  • Prepares and submits VA comments, ballot reconciliations, and change requests.
  • Coordinates VA participation so the right clinical and technical people show up to the right meetings with a consistent position, and follows through on commitments VA makes in those forums.
  • Maintains working relationships with SDO staff, cochairs, and counterparts at other federal agencies.
  • Gives the program early warning when a standard is moving in a direction that will create downstream work.

Standards Analysis and Program Advisory

  • Analyzes draft and published standards, implementation guides, and terminology releases for operational impact on VHA systems and workflows.
  • Translates what a standard actually requires into plain terms for informatics analysts, clinical SMEs, architects, and program leadership.
  • Advises on adoption timing, conformance expectations, gaps between a published standard and how VHA currently does the work, and the practical cost of closing that gap.
  • Supports requirements development and interoperability design decisions where standards conformance is in play.
  • Flags conflicts between competing standards, or between a standard and existing VA policy, and works the issue toward a decision rather than handing it off.

Knowledge Management

  • Owns the program’s knowledge management approach for standards and interoperability content.
  • Builds and maintains the repository structure, taxonomy, naming conventions, and version control that keep artifacts findable and current.

Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of Agility's largest and most strategic clients, with a primary mandate to grow those accounts, expanding revenue, deepening product adoption, and broadening Agility's footprint across the organization. Acting as a trusted executive advisor, you'll build relationships with C-suite and senior leadership, orchestrate cross-functional resources, and lead sophisticated account strategies that turn satisfied customers into expanding, multi-year partners.

You'll be joining a company with more than 20 years of industry expertise, helping communications, PR, and marketing teams solve real business challenges through media intelligence, monitoring, and AI-powered insights.

This is a relationship-driven, growth-focused role where success is measured by net revenue expansion across your portfolio. You'll inherit an established book of enterprise accounts and be responsible for identifying, building, and closing upsell, cross-sell, and multi-year expansion opportunities, alongside protecting the base through strong renewal outcomes.

Reporting to the Managing Director, UK, you'll serve as the strategic and commercial owner of your accounts, with growth as your north star. Working closely with Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Marketing, you'll uncover whitespace within existing organizations, build the business case for expansion, and lead your accounts toward their next stage of investment in Agility.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on account growth — who sees every enterprise relationship as a portfolio of untapped opportunity, enjoys navigating complex, multi-threaded stakeholder environments, and is energized by hitting expansion targets, not just retention numbers.

What you’ll do

As a key member of our Enterprise Account Management team, you'll manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients, with growth as your primary objective — while ensuring retention as the foundation that makes growth possible.

Drive Account Growth

  • Serve as the primary strategic and commercial relationship owner for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, with net revenue expansion as your core success metric.
  • Build and execute account growth plans that map whitespace, identify new buying centers, and outline a multi-year path to expand Agility's footprint within each organization.
  • Proactively identify, qualify, and lead upsell, cross-sell, and multi-product expansion opportunities across departments and business units.
  • Lead complex, multi-year contract negotiations and renewal discussions, structuring deals that maximize long-term account value for both the client and Agility.
  • Deliver executive business reviews (EBRs) that quantify value delivered, tie platform impact to client business outcomes, and build the case for continued investment and expansion.
  • Build and maintain a healthy, multi-quarter pipeline of expansion opportunities across your portfolio, with disciplined forecasting of growth revenue.
  • Own quota attainment for expansion and renewal revenue across a concentrated portfolio of high-value accounts.

Strategic Partnership & Executive Engagement

  • Build trusted, executive-level relationships with C-suite and senior decision-makers, expanding relationships beyond the original champion into new stakeholders and departments.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's evolving business priorities, strategic initiatives, and organizational structure to uncover new growth opportunities.
  • Lead strategic, boardroom-level conversations that connect Agility's expanding solution set to clients' long-term goals.
  • Navigate multi-threaded, multi-department buying environments — including procurement, legal, and security — to structure and close expansion deals.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, who lead onboarding, adoption, and day-to-day engagement, while you own account strategy, growth planning, and executive relationships.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, bringing insights, benchmarking data, and best practices that position Agility as essential to the client's growth, not just a vendor to retain.

Forecasting & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate, multi-quarter growth and renewal forecasts in Salesforce, providing leadership visibility into expansion pipeline, account health, and risk.
  • Track portfolio performance against growth and retention targets, with a clear view of net revenue retention (NRR) by account.
  • Develop and execute account-specific growth strategies for high-potential accounts, and mitigation plans for at-risk accounts that could limit expansion.
  • Provide leadership with account-level insights that inform growth strategy, revenue planning, and resource allocation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Orchestrate cross-functional "deal teams" — Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing — around growth opportunities in top accounts.
  • Partner with Product to align account growth strategies with the product roadmap, identifying which upcoming capabilities unlock expansion in specific accounts.
  • Work with Marketing to develop account-based marketing initiatives, executive events, and content that support expansion motions.
  • Advocate for customer feedback internally, helping shape product direction in ways that create new growth vectors within your accounts.
  • Contribute to a seamless customer experience by aligning internal teams around each account's growth trajectory.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of enterprise account management, growth, or strategic sales experience within a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of expanding accounts (upsell, cross-sell, multi-year renewals).
  • Demonstrated success consistently meeting or exceeding expansion/growth revenue targets, not just retention.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts, including navigating procurement, legal, and security review processes.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS growth metrics (NRR, expansion ARR, whitespace analysis) and value-based, consultative selling.
  • Exceptional executive presence — communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills across C-suite and senior leadership.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, able to build compelling business cases and translate account data into growth strategy.
  • Experience with enterprise sales/growth methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Command of the Message) is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM tools; experience with customer success and account-planning platforms is a plus.
  • Highly organized, autonomous, and comfortable managing a concentrated portfolio of high-value strategic accounts in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Fully remote work environment 
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it 
  • Competitive compensation package 
  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits 
  • RRSP matching 
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities  
  • Paid Vacation, Personal Days and Sick days 
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years' 
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

The total compensation for this role is expected to fall within the range of CA$155,000 - CA170,000 OTE annually. The final offer will reflect each candidate’s experience, skills, and internal equity.
This is for a vacant position.

AI Usage
We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates.
AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage.
We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability status or sexual orientation.

Roles & Responsibilities

A SAP Basis Administrator is responsible for the technical administration, stability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of SAP systems. While functional consultants (SD, MM, FICO, etc.) focus on business processes, Basis administrators manage the underlying SAP landscape.

Core Responsibilities

1. SAP System Installation & Configuration

  • Install SAP systems and components
  • Configure application servers and databases
  • Set up development, QA, training, and production environments
  • Perform system copies and client copies

2. System Monitoring & Administration

  • Monitor SAP system health
  • Manage work processes
  • Check system logs and dumps
  • Monitor CPU, memory, disk space, and network utilization
  • Ensure system availability and uptime

3. User Administration & Security Support

  • Create and maintain SAP users
  • Assign roles and profiles
  • Lock/unlock accounts
  • Manage password policies
  • Support GRC and audit requirements

4. Performance Tuning

  • Analyze system bottlenecks
  • Optimize database performance
  • Tune SAP buffers
  • Analyze expensive SQL statements
  • Coordinate with DBAs and developers

5. Transport Management

One of the most important Basis functions.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage transport landscape
  • Import/export transports
  • Resolve transport failures
  • Coordinate releases across environments

6. Patch & Upgrade Management

  • Apply SAP Support Packages
  • Implement SAP Notes
  • Upgrade SAP releases
  • Perform kernel upgrades
  • Support S/4HANA migrations

7. Database Administration

Often shared with a DBA team.

Tasks:

  • Database backups
  • Recovery testing
  • Performance monitoring
  • HANA administration
  • Space management

Platforms:

  • SAP HANA
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server
  • DB2

8. Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Schedule backups
  • Validate recovery procedures
  • Maintain DR environments
  • Execute recovery testing

Key Goal:

  • Meet RTO (Recovery Time Objective)
  • Meet RPO (Recovery Point Objective)

9. SAP HANA Administration

In S/4HANA environments, Basis often manages:

  • HANA Studio
  • HANA Cockpit
  • Replication
  • Tenant databases
  • HANA security
  • HANA performance optimization

10. Interface & Connectivity Support

Basis supports technical connectivity for:

  • SAP PI/PO
  • SAP CPI
  • RFC connections
  • IDocs
  • Web Services
  • Middleware integrations

11. High Availability & System Architecture

Design and support:

  • Load balancing
  • Clustering
  • Failover
  • Distributed SAP landscapes
  • Cloud deployments

Requirements

  • User administration
  • Monitoring
  • Basic transport management
  • Backup monitoring

Mid-Level Basis Administrator

  • System refreshes
  • Performance tuning

Senior Basis Administrator

jobs.excerpt: We Are:The beginning of a new Data & AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun.
jobs.description:
We Are:

The beginning of a new Data & AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data & AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry-defining work.

With over 45,000 professionals dedicated to Data & AI, Accenture’s Data & AI organization brings together our Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and Power Ecosystem.

You are:

Bring deep technical and domain expertise to AI programs at health plans — designing solutions that work inside the realities of core administrative platforms and the claims and member data that flow through them, where AI can ease the burden of adjudication, prior authorization, utilization management, and member and provider service. You'll help payers put AI to work across both the operational and clinical realities of their environment and help define the future of healthcare interoperability.

The Work:

  • Lead forward-deployed pods. Own AI programs end-to-end inside health plans, PBMs, and payer operations — directing multiple concurrent workstreams and aligning claims operations, utilization and care management, network and provider data, and analytics and actuarial leaders around outcomes, from architecture through adoption.

  • Scope the program. Define the problem, the intended outcome, and what good looks like — and identify where AI can automate or augment administrative and clinical work.

  • Set and govern the technical architecture. Architect and govern AI programs across payer environments at program scale — spanning multi-system integration across core administrative, claims, and clinical platforms — and articulate it clearly, on paper and in diagrams, for engineers, business and clinical leaders, and executives alike.

  • Design for trust. Make sure the solutions you shape are safe, compliant, and fair — building in the human oversight, transparency, and PHI safeguards that AI touching coverage and payment decisions demands.

  • Reimagine the way of working. Reimagine the future way of working for operations and clinical teams, rather than simply automating today's processes.

  • Shape interoperability. Help define the future of healthcare interoperability — how plans, providers, and the broader ecosystem can connect around claims and clinical data in a deep, meaningful way.

  • Lead and develop the team. Set delivery standards and pace, coach junior FDEs through co-delivery, and own performance management and growth for the engineers in your pod.

  • Shape strategy with executives. Partner with client CIO, CFO, Chief Medical Officer, and health-plan leadership to shape AI reinvention strategy — building value architecture, ROI backlogs, use-case prioritization frameworks, and multi-year adoption roadmaps, with commercial metrics attached.

  • Build the practice. Define and publish reusable methods, blueprints, and accelerators that scale across payer engagements — codifying delivery learnings and engineering standards that grow the FDE practice and develop the next generation of forward-deployed engineers.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need

  • Minimum of 8 years of hands-on engineering experience with cloud-native systems — APIs, microservices, containerization, and serverless — including working with AI platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Vertex AI, or open-source models) and at least 1 year designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production

  • Minimum8 years of experience hands-on coding in at least one general-purpose language (e.g., Python, Java) and the ability to pick up others as engagements demand

  • Minimum8 years of experience with hands-on production deployment experience — CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging — with demonstrated end-to-end delivery ownership in a client-embedded environment

  • Minimum3 years of experience delivering AI or technology programs inside payer organizations.

  • Minimum3 years hands-on experience using Claude or an equivalent frontier AI tool to do the work.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Professional Skills Requirements:

  • Deep understanding of how core administrative and claims platforms work and how claims and member data are structured, with direct QNXT, Facets, HealthEdge, or comparable experience

  • Fluency with data — non-trivial SQL, relational modeling, and reasoning about data quality and data lineage

  • Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and EDI mechanisms: X12 transaction flows (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278, 834), FHIR APIs, and the broader exchange landscape

  • Deep understanding of payer workflows — how coverage and payment actually work across eligibility and enrollment, claims adjudication, prior authorization and utilization management, provider network and reimbursement, appeals and grievances, and risk and quality programs — including a real sense of where administrative burden and cost accumulate and where AI can meaningfully relieve it, and how the regulatory environment (HIPAA and CMS requirements) shapes what solutions can look like

  • AI solution architecture and AI program scoping, with strong written and presentation skills

  • Comfortable working forward-deployed, embedded directly with health plans in a fast-iterating model

  • High tolerance for ambiguity and the patience to make things work inside slow-moving, high-stakes IT environments

Technical fundamentals:

The technology fundamentals expected of any capable full-stack engineer building AI solutions in a healthcare environment:

  • How the web works end to end: HTTP/HTTPS, the request/response lifecycle, REST APIs, and JSON.

  • API design and integration: authentication, pagination, rate limits, retries, versioning, and event-driven patterns (webhooks, batch file feeds); comfortable reading and building against unfamiliar API documentation, including FHIR and payer platform and clearinghouse APIs.

  • Data fundamentals: relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, and SQL — applied to the messy, real-world claims, eligibility, and clinical data these programs run on.

  • Working with frontier AI: the fundamentals of building with large language models — prompting, grounding responses in real data (retrieval / RAG), structured outputs and tool use, and evaluating quality while designing around non-determinism and the need for human oversight.

  • Security and handling PHI: authentication vs. authorization, token-based auth (OAuth / JWT), validating all input (never trust the client), and the essentials of protecting sensitive health data — encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access, and audit logging.

  • A practical feel for system tradeoffs: caching, queues and background jobs, idempotency, and when work should run in-request versus asynchronously.

We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineer for Devices/IoT to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as Consumer Electronics. We are looking for candidates who are accomplished Linux plumbers. If you are someone passionate about Linux, who knows the plumbing of the OS inside and out, who is proficient with distribution packaging, software design, system debugging, and bringing customer's ideas to life, then please keep on reading - this may be a uniquely exciting opportunity for you.

jobs.description:
DELFI Diagnostics, Inc. (DELFI Diagnostics) is developing next-generation, blood-based tests that are reliable, accessible and deliver a new way to help detect cancer. Employing advanced machine-learning methods to whole-genome sequencing data, the DELFI ("DNA EvaLuation of Fragments for early Interception") platform is built to address the highest-burden health challenges. DELFI Diagnostics prioritizes solutions that have the potential to save lives on a global scale, including for historically underserved populations. DELFI Diagnostics’ platform relies on fragmentomics – the discovery that cancer cells are more chaotic than normal cells and, when they die, leave behind tell-tale patterns and characteristics of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) fragments. FirstLook Lung, for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, is DELFI Diagnostics’ first laboratory-developed screening test and can be part of routine blood work. FirstLook Lung uses millions of data points to reliably identify individuals who may have cancer detected through low-dose CT, including early stage disease with a negative predictive value of 99.8 percent. This test has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.

In our passionate pursuit to radically improve health outcomes, we serve humanity when we:

  • Lead with Science, Anchor in Pragmatism: We pioneer life-changing science by ensuring quality, transparency, and rigor at all times. We explore thoughtfully, experiment smartly, and deliver impact with conviction.

  • Build With & For All: We embrace diverse backgrounds to innovate and achieve together. We are not just building a product - we aim to disrupt the path of cancer for all - no matter geography or socioeconomic class

  • Put We over I: We are a home for high-performing people. Through teamwork, we build collective intelligence. Each of us wins when those we serve and those who serve with us--win. We show up with empathy, humility, and integrity at every step of the journey.

About the role

    DELFI is approaching a series of time-critical milestones for the DELFI-L201 (CASCADE) IVD Clinical Validation study. We are seeking an experienced contract Clinical Data Manager (CDM) to provide supplemental CDM capacity through this critical period.

What you'll do

    Core CDM Execution

  • Perform ongoing data cleaning and query management in the study EDC and data collection systems

  • Conduct data review, discrepancy management, medical coding support (as needed), and reconciliation activities, including sample-to-clinical data reconciliation

  • Work from data quality report output produced by DELFI's data team, translating findings into queries and resolutions

  • Support CRF freeze/lock readiness and database lock preparation

  • Participate in study team meetings and provide brief weekly written status summaries covering work completed and risks/blockers

    • Specification Development

  • Develop and finalize Derived Variable (DV) specifications and requirements documentation using DELFI templates and conventions

  • Support Table, Figure, and Listing (TFL) specifications, including review against the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP)

  • Provide limited statistical programming or implementation support for derived variables and TFL-related datasets, as skills allow

What you'll bring

    Required (both levels)

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on clinical data management experience in a pharmaceutical, medical device/diagnostic company, or CRO

  • Direct experience supporting database lock activities in clinical trials

  • Proficiency with Medidata Rave EDC

  • Ability to work independently with minimal ramp-up, and excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills

    • Required (Senior level)

  • 5+ years of CDM experience, including experience authoring DV and/or TFL specifications

  • Ability to read and interpret a Statistical Analysis Plan and translate it into specification documents

    • Preferred

  • Experience in oncology, diagnostics, or IVD/regulated device studies

  • R programming experience

  • Familiarity with leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini) to streamline clinical data management workflows, data review, or scripting tasks

  • Familiarity with Clario or comparable imaging/adjudication data platforms

jobs.excerpt: Date Posted:2026-09-16Country:United States of AmericaLocation: Florida - RemoteWHY JOIN FCS At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them.
jobs.description:
Date Posted:

2026-09-16

Country:

United States of America

Location:

Florida - Remote

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

SUMMARY

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Pharmacy Officer (CPO) is the senior-most executive accountable for the strategy, performance, and advancement of the enterprise pharmacy business at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, including Pharmacy Operations, RxToGo, Pharmacy Solutions, and Centralized Procurement. The CPO establishes the enterprise vision and strategic priorities for medically integrated dispensing, oral and infusion pharmacy services, drug acquisition, and procurement, while leading through a high-performing team accountable for operational execution.

The CPO provides leadership and accountability for clinical quality, regulatory integrity, patient access, growth, and financial performance across the pharmacy enterprise. Serving as a trusted partner to physician leadership, the executive team, and the Board, this leader collaborates across Clinical, Operations, Finance, Managed Care, Revenue Cycle, Legal, Compliance, IT, Strategic Initiatives, and People & Culture to align pharmacy strategy with enterprise priorities and deliver sustainable organizational value.

The successful executive will combine strategic perspective, strong business and clinical judgment, and disciplined accountability with a collaborative leadership style. The CPO must be willing to engage directly in critical matters, major negotiations, and enterprise risks while operating primarily through senior leaders and teams responsible for day-to-day execution.

PRIMARY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Establish and lead the enterprise pharmacy strategy, aligning Pharmacy Operations, RxToGo, Pharmacy Solutions, and Centralized Procurement with the FCS mission, values, and long-term strategic plan.

  • Maintain executive accountability for the overall performance of the pharmacy enterprise, including clinical quality, regulatory integrity, patient access, growth, financial outcomes, and organizational readiness.

  • Translate enterprise strategy into clear priorities, outcomes, and performance expectations for senior pharmacy and procurement leaders, holding the leadership team accountable for effective execution.

  • Partner with physician leadership, the executive team, and key functional stakeholders to ensure pharmacy strategy supports clinical priorities, operational needs, financial objectives, patient access, and sustainable growth.

  • Define the strategic direction and growth agenda for RxToGo and other medically integrated dispensing and specialty pharmacy capabilities, with accountability for patient experience, clinical outcomes, access, and business performance.

  • Set the enterprise strategy for pharmaceutical sourcing, drug acquisition, procurement, supply resilience, and vendor partnerships, ensuring alignment with clinical, financial, and operational priorities.

  • Provide executive oversight of pharmacy compliance, accreditation, medication safety, and quality, establishing effective governance and holding leaders accountable for maintaining regulatory integrity and organizational readiness.

  • Chair the Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committee, partnering with physician and clinical leaders to advance evidence-based formulary decisions, clinical stewardship, pathway alignment, and responsible resource utilization.

  • Develop the pharmacy and procurement components of the enterprise operating and capital plans in collaboration with Finance and other key stakeholders, and communicate performance, risks, and opportunities to the executive team and Board.

  • Establish an enterprise performance framework for pharmacy and procurement, using meaningful clinical, operational, financial, access, and quality measures to guide decisions and reinforce accountability.

  • Collaborate with Managed Care, Revenue Cycle, Finance, physician leadership, and other stakeholders to shape payer, PBM, manufacturer, reimbursement, limited-distribution drug, and patient-affordability strategies.

  • Partner with IT, Clinical, Operations, and other stakeholders to establish the pharmacy technology, data, and automation roadmap, prioritizing investments that improve safety, access, outcomes, efficiency, and enterprise decision-making.

  • Provide executive sponsorship for pharmacy and procurement priorities associated with practice acquisitions, integrations, new site development, and other enterprise growth initiatives.

  • Represent FCS in strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, GPOs, industry associations, regulatory bodies, and other external partners.

  • Lead or provide executive oversight for major negotiations, strategic partnerships, and high-value enterprise agreements affecting pharmacy and procurement.

  • Build, develop, and hold accountable a high-performing senior leadership team, ensuring clear decision rights, effective delegation, strong succession planning, and continued leadership development.

  • Foster a culture of patient focus, safety, quality, collaboration, continuous improvement, and accountability throughout the pharmacy enterprise.

  • Partner across Clinical, Operations, Finance, Managed Care, Revenue Cycle, Legal, Compliance, IT, Strategic Initiatives, and People & Culture to resolve cross-functional priorities and advance enterprise objectives.

  • Serve as an executive thought partner to the CEO and executive leadership on market dynamics, oncology drug economics, reimbursement, pharmacy policy, emerging risks, and strategic opportunities.

  • Remain sufficiently connected to the business to understand execution challenges and intervene directly when significant enterprise risk, performance concerns, critical escalations, or major negotiations require executive leadership.

  • Perform other duties and lead special initiatives as assigned in support of enterprise priorities.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated success leading a complex, multi-site pharmacy enterprise through senior leaders, with accountability for clinical, financial, regulatory, growth, and patient-access outcomes.

  • Experience establishing enterprise strategy and translating it into clear priorities, governance, performance expectations, and measurable results.

  • Strong understanding of pharmacy operations, medically integrated dispensing, specialty pharmacy, procurement, and supply chain, with the ability to provide informed executive oversight without becoming the primary owner of routine execution.

  • Proven ability to develop high-performing leadership teams, delegate effectively, establish clear accountability, and build organizational capabilities at scale.

  • Demonstrated success collaborating with physician leaders, executive peers, Boards, and cross-functional teams to address complex clinical and business priorities.

  • Experience leading strategic partnerships, significant negotiations, integrations, and enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.

  • Executive-level knowledge of oncology drug economics, reimbursement, payer and PBM dynamics, sourcing, procurement, medication safety, and pharmacy regulatory requirements.

  • Ability to move appropriately between enterprise strategy and direct executive engagement when business conditions, risk, or organizational priorities require it.

SCREENINGS – Background, drug, and nicotine screens

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. In addition, FCS is a drug-free workplace, and all new hires will be subject to drug/ nicotine testing.Medical Marijuana cards are not recognized.

EEOC

Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute (FCS) is committed to helping individuals with disabilities to participate in the workforce and ensure equal opportunity to compete for jobs. If you require an accommodation to submit a resume for positions at FCS, please email FCS Recruitment () for further assistance. Please note this email address is intended to request an accommodation as part of the application process. Any other correspondence will not receive a response.

FCS is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

JayWay Travel is approaching its 20th anniversary and has grown into an international travel company with a team of 100+ people across more than 20 countries.

We create personalized travel experiences across Europe, Latin America, and other destinations, helping travelers turn their ideas into memorable journeys.

Our team brings together travel enthusiasts, marketers, sales professionals, planners, and problem-solvers — all working toward creating great experiences for our guests.

Are You a Marketing Professional Who Likes to Get Things Done?

We’re looking for an experienced marketing professional who understands brands, enjoys working with people, and is comfortable taking an idea and figuring out how to make it happen.

This is a broad, cross-functional role covering areas such as brand, guest experience, partnerships, and marketing operations. You’ll work closely with the Head of Department and with teams across JayWay to keep projects moving, spot opportunities, and make sure the way we present and deliver JayWay feels consistent.

No two days will necessarily look the same — and that’s part of the appeal.

And don’t worry if you don’t tick every box or have experience in every area listed. We’re interested in how you think, how you approach challenges, and how you turn ideas into action.

What Will You Do?

  • Help manage the JayWay brand across our marketing and guest-facing communications, keeping our voice, messaging, and visual identity consistent.
  • Look at the guest experience across different touchpoints, using feedback, reviews, and other insights to identify what’s working and where we can improve.
  • Research and help develop new partnerships and commercial opportunities that could add value for our guests and our business.
  • Coordinate projects involving internal teams, agencies, freelancers, designers, creators, and other external partners.
  • Keep marketing projects organized, including timelines, budgets, vendors, tools, and documentation.
  • Maintain and improve brand guidelines, templates, processes, and other resources used by the wider team.
  • Keep an eye on industry trends, guest expectations, competitors, and new opportunities, and bring useful ideas to the Head of Department.
  • Help make sure projects are delivered on time, to a high standard, and in a way that feels right for JayWay.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

You’ve already spent a few years working in marketing or a related field and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

We’d expect you to have:

  • 3+ years of experience in brand management, integrated marketing, communications, guest/customer experience, partnerships, business development, marketing operations, or a related area.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams and levels of the organization.
  • Good commercial instincts and an understanding of what makes something valuable for both the customer and the business.
  • Excellent organization and attention to detail — especially when several projects are happening at once.
  • The ability to work with both creative ideas and practical details, from a campaign concept to a budget, deadline, vendor, or approval.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to turn feedback, data, and research into useful recommendations.
  • A proactive approach. If you see something that could be better, you’re the kind of person who will raise it and help find a solution.

Experience in travel, hospitality, tourism, luxury, lifestyle, destination marketing, or another high-touch service business is a plus, but it’s not essential.

Tools & Platforms

You should be comfortable learning and working with a range of tools. Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Milanote, WordPress, ClickUp, Muck Rack, or similar marketing and project-management platforms is a plus.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Competitive pay & performance bonuses that recognize your impact.
  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to collaborate across 20+ countries.
  • Annual all-company gatherings in breathtaking European locations.
  • Full support with work-from-home setup and equipment.
  • Wellness programs and travel insurance.
  • Covered travel expenses for business-related trips.

Our Hiring Process

We believe in human-led recruitment — no AI filters. Here’s what you can expect:

  1. Short one-way video questionnaire to learn more about your background.
  2. Initial video interview with our HR team.
  3. Job-related task to see how you approach the work.
  4. Interview with our executive marketing team.

We’ll review your application personally and aim to keep the process straightforward and respectful of your time.

Ready to Join Us?

If you have solid marketing experience, enjoy working across different areas, and like being the person who spots an opportunity and figures out what to do with it, we’d love to hear from you.

You don’t need to have done everything listed above.

What matters is that you’re curious, capable, organized, commercially aware, and comfortable taking ownership.

Think this sounds like you? Apply now.

Please submit your CV in English to get started.

We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

👉 Explore JayWay’s story

JayWay Travel Inc. is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, with recruitment and selection decisions based solely on qualifications and merit, without regard to protected characteristics.

In this pivotal role, you will report to the Senior Director of R&D Electronic Warfare and lead the definition and development of next-generation Networked Electronic Warfare (EW) systems.

The successful individual in this role will bridge the gap between complex RF hardware, advanced signal processing software, and distributed networking architectures. You will work within a multi-disciplinary team to architect systems that not only detect and counter threats but coordinate these effects across a mesh of intelligent nodes. This position requires a rigorous systems engineering approach to capture designs, manage requirements, and ensure mission success in contested RF environments.

  • Integration & Test Leadership: Define and oversee system integration strategies; lead hands-on integration events involving RF hardware, embedded software, and network emulators in both lab and field environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the technical bridge between RF, FPGA, Software, and Mechanical engineering teams, facilitating trade studies to balance performance, SWaP (Size, Weight, and Power), and cost.

Background

CLEAR Global is powered by a global community of over 200,000 linguists, who give their time and skills to help people access information in the language they understand. Keeping this community informed, connected, and engaged is essential to our work. The role

The Advocacy Intern-Nigeria will work directly with the Advocacy Officer along with other members of the team to support the planning, coordination and implementation of an advocacy campaign to advance digital language justice in Nigeria.

The role will support efforts to ensure that people who speak marginalised languages are able to access, participate in and shape the digital world in the languages they understand.

The intern will contribute to campaign planning, stakeholder mapping, coalition building, policy engagement, communications, campaign coordination and monitoring. They will support the identification of key decision makers and influencers, develop and maintain relationships with campaign allies, track advocacy opportunities, and help translate research evidence into compelling campaign messages and demands.

Qualifications

The right candidate is an energetic team player and multitasker who agrees with CLEAR Global´s basic beliefs and values and who can work virtually with team members based throughout the world.

  • Strong writing skills in English, and excellent spoken English; proficiency in other languages relevant to humanitarian action a plus

  • Flexibility and ability to innovate to find creative solutions

CLEAR Global exists to help people get vital information, and be heard, whatever language they speak. We believe that everyone has the right to give and receive information in a language and format they understand. We work with nonprofit partners and a global community of language professionals to build local language translation capacity, and raise awareness of language barriers. Our network of over 200,000 community members translate millions of words of life-saving and life-changing information a year.

Core values

CLEAR Global employees and volunteers are people who believe passionately about the value of this work and take personal responsibility for achieving the mission. CLEAR Global’s mission and organizational spirit embody the core values established in its strategic framework:

  • Excellence: As the leading voice for communicating humanitarian information in the right language, CLEAR Global is a leader in the translation industry and in the non-profit sector.

  • Tolerance: Our staff and volunteers are highly knowledgeable and skilled; value each other, our partner and our recipients; create a supportive work environment; and conduct themselves professionally at all times.

Do głównych obowiązków Audit Booking Coordinator należy:

Job Description:

Remote Canada

Overview

We’re a software company at the start of building a brand-new, highly visible SaaS application. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the technical foundation: you’ll help set technical direction, establish engineering standards, and ship foundational capabilities that will shape the product for years. We’re looking for a motivated senior engineer who thinks and builds with an AI-first mindset—someone excited about agentic AI workflows, automation, and using modern AI tooling to accelerate delivery without compromising quality. This project will be using AI-Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) to drive the creation, testing and deployment of this application. This is a tremendous opportunity to be fully supported in an AI first approach.

In this role, you’ll design and implement core backend systems using .NET/C# and proven architectural patterns such as Event Sourcing, CQRS, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Vertical Slice (vertical event-sourced) architectures. You’ll work in a cloud-native environment leveraging AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and Docker, contributing to a platform built for scale, reliability, and rapid iteration. You’ll also be a technical leader—taking ownership, mentoring others, and helping define best practices for a high-performing team.

Responsibilities

  • Own major components of a new SaaS platform from design through production

  • Build event-sourced, CQRS-based services in C#/.NET using DDD principles

  • Design clean domain models, message contracts, and integration patterns using RabbitMQ

  • Deliver cloud-ready solutions using Docker and AWS (deployment, observability, reliability)

  • Apply an AI-first approach to engineering: agentic AI tools, automated workflows, code generation/review, test generation, and productivity accelerators

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define architecture, standards, and delivery practices

  • Write high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code and raise the bar through reviews and mentorship

Must Have

  • AI-first mentality with practical experience using AI tools to accelerate development

  • Senior-level experience building production systems with C#/.NET

  • Hands-on experience with Event Sourcing and CQRS in real-world systems

  • Strong working knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

  • Experience with Vertical Slice architecture (or similar modular service boundaries)

  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL

  • Experience with asynchronous messaging and integration patterns, ideally RabbitMQ

  • Experience containerizing services with Docker

  • Experience building/operating cloud-hosted applications, ideally on AWS

  • Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (autonomous workflows, tool-using agents, orchestration, evaluation/guardrails) and excitement to apply them in day-to-day engineering

  • Strong ownership mindset: you ship, you improve, you operate, you lead

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MartenDB

  • Experience with Wolverine

  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS systems (auth, billing, isolation, scaling, observability)

  • Familiarity with modern DevOps/IaC practices (e.g., Terraform/CDK), CI/CD, and distributed tracing

This position helps ensure investigator sites are prepared, compliant, and activated on schedule, enabling the successful delivery of clinical trials that bring new treatments to patients.

You will collaborate closely with investigator sites, study teams, regulatory stakeholders, and cross functional partners to manage essential documentation, support regulatory submissions, maintain clinical trial systems, and drive operational excellence throughout the study lifecycle. This role offers the opportunity to build deep expertise in site activation, regulatory processes, and clinical trial operations while contributing directly to the success of global research programs.

You will join a fast paced, growth-oriented environment focused on delivering high quality site activation, regulatory compliance, and study execution. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Site Activation Partner can explore career growth and expand expertise across clinical research operations.

  • Lead and coordinate site activation activities and essential document management to support timely site initiation and study start-up.

  • Work directly with investigator sites to assess readiness, review site information, and ensure completion of Investigator Initiation Package requirements.
