  • Manage investigator site registration and maintenance within client systems, registries, and clinical trial platforms while ensuring inspection readiness.

  • Collaborate with study teams and supporting functions to achieve timely site activation and operational milestones.

  • Support ethics committee and IRB submissions, communications, approvals, and ongoing maintenance activities as required by local regulations.

  • Coordinate document translation activities with approved vendors when applicable.

  • Manage essential document collection, maintenance, filing, archiving, and trial master file contributions in accordance with procedures and quality standards.

  • Maintain accurate clinical trial systems and tracking tools used to monitor site compliance, documentation status, and study performance.

  • Support investigator sites and study teams in preparation for audits and inspections and assist with responses when required.

  • Identify, resolve, and escalate site related issues as appropriate while supporting corrective and preventive actions.

  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, system expertise, knowledge sharing, and mentoring activities as assigned.

Candidate Profile

You will thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strong organizational, documentation management, and stakeholder engagement skills

  • Experience working in clinical research, site activation, or a regulated environment

  • The ability to collaborate across global teams and communicate effectively with investigator sites and study stakeholders

  • A quality focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to compliance

  • Comfort working with CTMS, eTMF, eISF, document exchange portals, Shared Investigator Platform, and related clinical systems

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Minimum 2 years' relevant experience in clinical site management in study site activation

  • Knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable global and local regulatory requirements

  • Experience working with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), Electronic Trial Master Files (eTMF), Electronic Investigator Site Files (eISF), and related clinical research systems

  • Experience supporting investigator site activation and regulatory documentation within sponsor or CRO environments

  • Experience using Shared Investigator Platform and document exchange portals

  • Strong communication, organization, problem solving, and multitasking skills

The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Overview

Reporting to a Production Editorial Manager, the Production Editorial Intern will be a key member of the team responsible for preparing books for publication during the final stages of development. In their role, the Production Editorial Intern will assist the department in its daily operations by reviewing typeset pages, printers’ proofs, and final PDFs to ensure that quality standards are met. They will also review book jackets and covers through various passes, collate proofreader and author changes to interior text files, check the inputting of corrections, apply layout standards, and complete cold reads when required. The Production Editorial Intern will work on a wide range of children’s and adult trade titles. Working as part of a collaborative and dedicated team, the Production Editorial Intern will be immersed in the day-to-day functioning of a busy department, working alongside colleagues in the Editorial and Design departments. They will also have the opportunity for one-on-one meetings with employees across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Review the interior and cover components of multiple books for typographical correctness and stylistic consistency through various passes
  • Collate author changes and proofreading corrections, ensuring that revisions are incorporated accurately and queries are resolved
  • Mark up PDFs (using Adobe Acrobat commenting tools) with editorial and layout corrections
  • Conduct production editorial checks on typeset pages (checking line breaks, text flow, folios, headers and footers, stacking, widows and orphans, formatting, sketch and art checks, etc.)
  • Proofread and fact-check cover copy
  • Copyedit/proofread ancillary documents, such as praise pages, marketing materials, reading group guides, etc.
  • Assist with bound galley production and reprint corrections as needed
  • Assist with administrative duties and keep status grids up to date
  • Attend departmental and company meetings as required

Qualifications

  • Candidates who are available to work in a full-time capacity in 2027 or 2028 are eligible for this internship; open to rising seniors, recent graduates, master’s students, or entry level candidates with up to 1 year of work experience.
  • Candidates must be available to work 21 hours per week across 3 or 4 days, from February 8 to April 16, 2027, at the location specified in the job description. This internship is compensated at a rate of $18 per hour.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.
  • A resume and cover letter are required; applications without a cover letter will not be considered. Please address your cover letter to “Hiring Team.” 
  • Ideal candidates are either currently enrolled in or have recently graduated from an undergraduate or master’s program.
  • A passion for books is highly valued!

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach's Legal team supports the business as a lean, fully remote group that blends deep commercial contracting expertise with legal operations discipline. The team partners closely with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, Business Systems, and Privacy to keep deals and processes moving, and covers both U.S. West Coast and East Coast hours to ensure reliable, always-on queue coverage. The team is actively modernizing how legal work gets done - from CLM and contract-repository tooling (Ironclad, Salesforce, Atlassian Jira, Mindtickle) to embedding AI into everyday contracting and operations workflows.

The Role

Outreach is hiring a Senior Contracts and Legal Operations Manager to join its Legal team. This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Legal and combines two complementary disciplines: commercial contracting and legal operations.

On the contracting side, you will provide coverage of Legal’s contracting queues during U.S. West Coast hours, independently handling intake, triage, and negotiation of agreements within defined templates, playbooks, and fallback positions. Attorneys remain actively involved in contracting, and you will coordinate closely with them on complex or non-standard matters.

On the operations side, you will shape the systems, processes, templates, and reporting that Legal and the broader business rely on, including driving AI adoption into Legal’s daily work and workflows.

The position offers broad cross-functional exposure across Sales, Business Systems, Finance, Revenue Operations, Privacy, and other teams. We are looking for a business-focused professional who delivers measurable results, exercises sound judgment, operates with independence within defined authority, and builds practical partnerships across the organization.

  • Du bewertest die Prozessschritte hinsichtlich ihrer Umsetzbarkeit im Rahmen einer digitalen Plattformlösung
  • Du entwickelst basierend auf deiner Bewertung Funktionsbausteine (z. B. Prozessdiagramme oder Use Case-Diagramme) für eine digitale Rückführungsplattform

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Informatik oder ähnliches
  • Dich zeichnet eine selbstständige und engagierte sowie sorgfältige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Programmen

Das kannst Du erwarten:

  • Einblicke in das Industrie- und Forschungsgeschäft in Zusammenarbeit mit renommierten Unternehmen und Forschungspartnerinnen und -partnern
  • interessante, anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem qualifizierten und dynamischen Team
  • die Möglichkeit zu flexibler Zeiteinteilung und eigenständigem Arbeiten
  • ein modernes, kollegiales und digitales Arbeitsumfeld
  • Raum für Kreativität und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Die Upgrade Circular Economy ist ein vielversprechendes Konzept, um signifikante ökologische Einsparungen mit ökonomischen Chancen zu verbinden. Ihre Realisierung erfordert einen konstanten, planbaren Rückfluss gebrauchter Produkte. Nur dann können sie aufbereitet, upgegradet und erneut vermarktet werden. Doch genau hier liegen aktuell große Hürden: Viele Unternehmen kämpfen mit beschränkter Produktverfügbarkeit, intransparentem Zustandswissen und fragmentierten Rückführungskanälen. Beispiele wie Rebuy oder Backmarket zeigen in eng umrissenen Nischen das Potenzial, welches digitale Plattformen für die Rückführung und Realisierung der Upgrade Circular Economy haben können. Im Rahmen dieser Abschlussarbeit soll ein strukturiertes Vorgehensmodell für den Reverse Logistics Prozess in der Upgrade Circular Economy entwickelt werden.

Requirements

  • Direct Experience: 5+ years managing influencer and creator marketing programs for a direct-to-consumer (DTC), subscription, or health brand.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Finance and Operations Assistant to support the day-to-day back-office operations of a growing multi-location automotive repair business. You will own vendor reconciliation, QuickBooks management, accounts receivable reporting, invoice processing, and employee timekeeping — keeping the financial and administrative side of the business clean, accurate, and running without things slipping through the cracks.

This is a reliability-first role. The most important qualities here are not advanced finance expertise but consistency, accountability, and follow-through. QuickBooks experience is a hard requirement. Everything else can be learned if the foundation is right. If you are organized, detail-oriented, trustworthy with financial data, and take genuine pride in making sure nothing falls through, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US Pacific Time hours, Monday through Saturday (schedule is flexible after onboarding)
  • Work directly with the owner of a growing multi-location business with real operational ownership from day one
  • Stable, long-term role with clear responsibilities and room to grow as the business expands

What You'll Work On

Vendor Reconciliation

  • Reconcile vendor statements in the first 10 days of each month by matching invoices to statements
  • Identify any unbilled or unshipped items and flag discrepancies for resolution
  • Ensure early payment discounts of 2 to 6 percent are identified and claimed where applicable

Invoice Processing and Payments

  • Submit approved invoices through payment software for owner review
  • Prepare invoices for check printing and mailing in coordination with the owner and business partner
  • Maintain organized records of all submitted and processed invoices

QuickBooks Management and Bookkeeping Support

  • Match credit card batch payments to daily bank deposits in QuickBooks
  • Pull accounts receivable reports on a regular basis and flag overdue accounts for follow-up
  • Support basic bookkeeping tasks and periodic cleanup to keep the books accurate and current
  • Generate standard financial reports as needed for owner review

Employee Timekeeping

  • Remote into the point-of-sale system at each shop location to review employee clock-in and clock-out records
  • Identify and flag any timekeeping issues, discrepancies, or missing entries for correction
  • Maintain accurate timekeeping records across all locations

Administrative and Operational Support

  • Support the owner with back-office administrative tasks and special projects as needed
  • Assist with occasional personal administrative tasks when requested
  • Maintain organized records, files, and documentation across all operational areas

What You Bring

  • Proven hands-on experience with QuickBooks — this is a hard requirement for this role
  • Solid understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting principles including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliation
  • Ability to pull and interpret standard financial reports without requiring advanced finance expertise
  • Highly reliable and consistent with strong follow-through on recurring tasks and deadlines
  • Detail-oriented with a zero-tolerance approach to errors in financial records and reconciliations
  • Comfortable working remotely into business systems and point-of-sale platforms
  • Trustworthy and discreet when handling sensitive financial and employee data
  • Available to work Monday through Saturday during US Pacific Time hours, at least during onboarding

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HR administrative tasks such as posting job listings, screening applicants, and conducting initial calls
  • Background supporting a small business owner or multi-location operation
  • Experience working with automotive, retail, or service-based businesses
  • Familiarity with payment processing software or accounts payable platforms
  • Prior experience in a finance or operations role covering both bookkeeping and administrative responsibilities

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your QuickBooks experience, and walking through how you handle a vendor reconciliation or accounts receivable process in a previous role

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are reliable, detail-oriented, comfortable with QuickBooks, and want to be the person a business owner depends on to keep the back office running cleanly without being followed up, this role gives you the stability and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of Agility's largest and most strategic clients, with a primary mandate to grow those accounts, expanding revenue, deepening product adoption, and broadening Agility's footprint across the organization. Acting as a trusted executive advisor, you'll build relationships with C-suite and senior leadership, orchestrate cross-functional resources, and lead sophisticated account strategies that turn satisfied customers into expanding, multi-year partners.

You'll be joining a company with more than 20 years of industry expertise, helping communications, PR, and marketing teams solve real business challenges through media intelligence, monitoring, and AI-powered insights.

This is a relationship-driven, growth-focused role where success is measured by net revenue expansion across your portfolio. You'll inherit an established book of enterprise accounts and be responsible for identifying, building, and closing upsell, cross-sell, and multi-year expansion opportunities, alongside protecting the base through strong renewal outcomes.

Reporting to the Managing Director, UK, you'll serve as the strategic and commercial owner of your accounts, with growth as your north star. Working closely with Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Marketing, you'll uncover whitespace within existing organizations, build the business case for expansion, and lead your accounts toward their next stage of investment in Agility.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on account growth — who sees every enterprise relationship as a portfolio of untapped opportunity, enjoys navigating complex, multi-threaded stakeholder environments, and is energized by hitting expansion targets, not just retention numbers.

What you’ll do

As a key member of our Enterprise Account Management team, you'll manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients, with growth as your primary objective — while ensuring retention as the foundation that makes growth possible.

Drive Account Growth

  • Serve as the primary strategic and commercial relationship owner for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, with net revenue expansion as your core success metric.
  • Build and execute account growth plans that map whitespace, identify new buying centers, and outline a multi-year path to expand Agility's footprint within each organization.
  • Proactively identify, qualify, and lead upsell, cross-sell, and multi-product expansion opportunities across departments and business units.
  • Lead complex, multi-year contract negotiations and renewal discussions, structuring deals that maximize long-term account value for both the client and Agility.
  • Deliver executive business reviews (EBRs) that quantify value delivered, tie platform impact to client business outcomes, and build the case for continued investment and expansion.
  • Build and maintain a healthy, multi-quarter pipeline of expansion opportunities across your portfolio, with disciplined forecasting of growth revenue.
  • Own quota attainment for expansion and renewal revenue across a concentrated portfolio of high-value accounts.

Strategic Partnership & Executive Engagement

  • Build trusted, executive-level relationships with C-suite and senior decision-makers, expanding relationships beyond the original champion into new stakeholders and departments.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's evolving business priorities, strategic initiatives, and organizational structure to uncover new growth opportunities.
  • Lead strategic, boardroom-level conversations that connect Agility's expanding solution set to clients' long-term goals.
  • Navigate multi-threaded, multi-department buying environments — including procurement, legal, and security — to structure and close expansion deals.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, who lead onboarding, adoption, and day-to-day engagement, while you own account strategy, growth planning, and executive relationships.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, bringing insights, benchmarking data, and best practices that position Agility as essential to the client's growth, not just a vendor to retain.

Forecasting & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate, multi-quarter growth and renewal forecasts in Salesforce, providing leadership visibility into expansion pipeline, account health, and risk.
  • Track portfolio performance against growth and retention targets, with a clear view of net revenue retention (NRR) by account.
  • Develop and execute account-specific growth strategies for high-potential accounts, and mitigation plans for at-risk accounts that could limit expansion.
  • Provide leadership with account-level insights that inform growth strategy, revenue planning, and resource allocation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Orchestrate cross-functional "deal teams" — Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing — around growth opportunities in top accounts.
  • Partner with Product to align account growth strategies with the product roadmap, identifying which upcoming capabilities unlock expansion in specific accounts.
  • Work with Marketing to develop account-based marketing initiatives, executive events, and content that support expansion motions.
  • Advocate for customer feedback internally, helping shape product direction in ways that create new growth vectors within your accounts.
  • Contribute to a seamless customer experience by aligning internal teams around each account's growth trajectory.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of enterprise account management, growth, or strategic sales experience within a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of expanding accounts (upsell, cross-sell, multi-year renewals).
  • Demonstrated success consistently meeting or exceeding expansion/growth revenue targets, not just retention.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts, including navigating procurement, legal, and security review processes.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS growth metrics (NRR, expansion ARR, whitespace analysis) and value-based, consultative selling.
  • Exceptional executive presence — communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills across C-suite and senior leadership.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, able to build compelling business cases and translate account data into growth strategy.
  • Experience with enterprise sales/growth methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Command of the Message) is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM tools; experience with customer success and account-planning platforms is a plus.
  • Highly organized, autonomous, and comfortable managing a concentrated portfolio of high-value strategic accounts in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Private Health Plan
  • Pension Plan
  • Group Income Protection
  • Life Assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Holiday and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

AI Usage
We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates.
AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage.
We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability status or sexual orientation.

Even if you find yourself not checking all the boxes of our listed requirements but you are excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you anyway. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application for this role, and other potential role matches open now or in the future.

If, at any stage of the application process, you require accommodation owing to disability or a medical need, please let us know at for us to make appropriate arrangements.

Thank you for your time in reviewing this opportunity, and we hope to hear from you should you find this the right fit!

The VP, Strategic Business Partner (SBP), a role that requires a balance of business acumen and interpersonal acuity, is accountable for developing new Precision AQ revenue opportunities within a limited set of existing larger Precision customer accounts by building strong client/stakeholder relationships, identifying high-value opportunities, promoting all Precision AQ capabilities, and monitoring competitive/pipeline developments.

  • Developing and executing annual strategic business plan to drive new revenue and sales growth of all Precision AQ products & services as measured by sales bookings—and directly accountable for large, market-leading life sciences companies
  • Building and maintaining relationships with clients (especially at the senior executive level), and leveraging these relationships to generate new business opportunities and drive revenue growth

  • Developing and executing annual strategic business plan to drive new revenue and sales for all Precision AQ products & services, as measured by sales bookings

  • Collaborate with Precision AQ service lines to inform budgets, forecasts, and metrics
  • Building and maintaining relationships with clients (especially at the senior executive level), and leveraging these relationships to generate new business opportunities and drive revenue growth
  • Engage life science clients—either individually or in group presentations—to create and cultivate new relationships that lead to additional revenue opportunities
  • Managing client opportunities from prospecting, solution development, SOW finalization, and successful transition to service lines implementation

  • Coordinate with Marketing and Sales Operations to inform strategic marketing and lead generation activities

jobs.title: Agentic GTM Lead – Growth Engineering & Demand Generation
jobs.excerpt: **PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **Location: Remote – Latin America Work Arrangement: Fully Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Compensation:$2,500–$3,500 USD/month Experience:4–6+ years Schedule: Full-Time | Strong overlap with U.
jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation:$2,500–$3,500 USD/month
Experience:4–6+ years
Schedule: Full-Time | Strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time required
Industry: Investment Management / Alternative Investments
Department: Go-To-Market / Growth

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for sophisticated investors, financial advisory firms, and multi-family offices.

The firm combines deep investment expertise with a technology-driven approach and is entering its next stage of growth. As its investment platform and partnerships expand, the company is building a scalable go-to-market engine to generate demand, strengthen its market presence, and support continued growth.

About the Role

We are looking for an Agentic GTM Lead who combines real engineering ability, commercial instinct, demand-generation experience, and financial market knowledge.

This is not a traditional marketing role, and it is not a pure engineering role.

You will build and own the systems that generate demand across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and AI-powered automation. You will connect the technical infrastructure behind these channels with measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified interest, booked meetings, and pipeline.

Most importantly, you bring the ideas.

You will not be handed a complete GTM playbook to execute. You are expected to identify new demand-generation opportunities, launch multiple experiments simultaneously, measure what works, quickly eliminate what does not, and scale the strategies that produce results.

This is a highly autonomous, hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys moving from an idea to a working system and then proving its commercial impact with data.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to build a sophisticated GTM engine from the ground up within a growing investment management business.

You will have significant ownership over how demand is created, measured, automated, and scaled.

You will be able to:

  • Build rather than simply manage existing marketing systems

  • Experiment across multiple acquisition channels

  • Apply AI and agentic workflows to real commercial problems

  • Connect engineering directly to pipeline and revenue

  • Develop systems that automate repetitive GTM work

  • Shape the company's content, social, outbound, and digital presence

  • Work with sophisticated financial products and audiences

What You'll Do

Build and Scale the GTM Engine

  • Develop new demand-generation ideas, channels, and experiments

  • Build systems across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and website acquisition

  • Turn successful experiments into repeatable and scalable growth systems

  • Rapidly stop or redesign initiatives that are not producing measurable results

  • Connect GTM infrastructure directly to qualified interest, meetings, pipeline, and revenue

Build Technical GTM Infrastructure

  • Work hands-on with APIs, SQL, Python and/or JavaScript

  • Build integrations between data sources, automation platforms, CRMs, and GTM systems

  • Create workflows using tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, and CRM platforms

  • Design lead enrichment, account scoring, personalization, sequencing, routing, and attribution systems

  • Build solutions rather than relying exclusively on no-code configuration

Build AI & Agentic Workflows

  • Design and deploy workflows using LLMs and AI agents

  • Automate research, content development, personalization, lead enrichment, and routing

  • Identify repetitive GTM processes that can be automated or augmented with AI

  • Build scalable systems that allow a small team to operate with significantly greater leverage

Own Demand Generation

  • Build and optimize outbound programs based on signals, data, and a clearly defined ICP

  • Develop demand through outbound, SEO/GEO, content, social, and other acquisition channels

  • Build measurable programs that generate qualified interest and booked meetings

  • Continuously test messaging, audiences, channels, landing pages, and sequences

Build the Content & Social Engine

  • Develop systems for producing and distributing podcasts, videos, webinars, social content, and thought leadership

  • Repurpose long-form content into multiple channel-specific assets

  • Build consistent visibility across platforms such as LinkedIn and X/Twitter

  • Help establish a credible voice for a sophisticated investment and wealth-management audience

Experiment & Measure

  • Run multiple experiments simultaneously rather than testing one channel at a time

  • Conduct structured A/B testing across messaging, channels, landing pages, and sequences

  • Build dashboards for demand generation, attribution, and pipeline contribution

  • Use evidence and commercial results to determine what gets scaled, changed, or eliminated

Required Qualifications

  • 4–6+ years of relevant experience across growth engineering, GTM engineering, demand generation, growth marketing, or related roles

  • Proven ability to generate original demand-generation ideas and independently turn them into experiments

  • Demonstrated demand-generation results through outbound, content, SEO/GEO, social, or similar channels

  • Ability to provide specific metrics or examples showing how your work generated leads, booked meetings, pipeline, or revenue

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability with APIs and SQL

  • Proficiency with at least one scripting language, preferably Python or JavaScript

  • Experience with automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

  • Hands-on experience working with CRM systems, integrations, data, and automation

  • Practical experience building with LLMs and AI/agent workflows

  • Strong commercial instinct and ability to connect technical builds to measurable business outcomes

  • Professional experience or strong working knowledge of finance, investing, asset management, or investment management

  • Strong experimentation and A/B testing mindset

  • Ability to build and own initiatives from 0 to 1

  • Strong design and UX judgment

  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment

  • Strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct professional experience in asset management or investment management

  • Experience with alternative investments and/or hedge funds

  • Strong personal or professional interest in financial markets and investing

  • Experience building a GTM, growth, or demand-generation function from scratch

  • Experience with data warehouses or analytics infrastructure such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt

  • Experience with attribution modeling

  • CFA, MBA, or other relevant finance/business education is a plus

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be based on your ability to create a measurable and scalable demand engine.

Key outcomes include:

  • A growing stream of qualified interest and booked meetings attributable to your GTM systems

  • Successful demand-generation experiments that can be scaled into repeatable programs

  • AI-powered and signal-based outbound systems actively generating opportunities

  • Consistent content and social distribution with measurable audience growth

  • Reliable measurement of demand and pipeline contribution

  • A continuous experimentation system that clearly identifies what should be scaled and what should be stopped

  • Existing GTM activities transformed into more automated, repeatable, and efficient systems

Why Join Us

You will join an environment where ideas are evaluated on merit, experimentation is encouraged, and ownership matters.

You will have the autonomy to determine how to reach the goal while being accountable for measurable outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who prefers building, shipping, measuring, and improving over spending months developing theoretical strategies.

If you are equally comfortable discussing APIs, AI agents, pipeline generation, A/B testing, and investment markets, this role offers the opportunity to bring those skills together in one highly impactful position.

Important Notes

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

  • Candidates must be able to maintain strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific demand-generation results and metrics from previous roles.

  • This is a hands-on builder position. Candidates whose experience is primarily managing agencies, teams, or pre-built marketing systems without directly building GTM infrastructure may not be the right fit.

  • Experience or strong knowledge of investment management, asset management, alternative investments, or related financial markets is important for success in this role.

We are looking for candidates across all levels of experience, from Graduate to Senior.

As part of the Ubuntu Security Team, you will work with some of the best and brightest people in technology to monitor, triage, respond to, and document new and existing vulnerabilities in open source software. This is an engineering-focused role that may also involve activities such as producing security assessments, building features, conducting code reviews, developing internal tools, engaging with the open source community, and participating in industry initiatives and events.

  • Auditing source code for vulnerabilities
  • Building features and tools to help teams strengthen the security of their products and contribute to the overall security of Ubuntu

  • You have a thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and techniques for fixing them

We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.

Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role:

We are looking for an SDE-2 Frontend-leaning Full-Stack Engineer to build the interface of CRM Opportunities, the deal and pipeline engine at the heart of our CRM. Opportunities is the system of record for every revenue motion our customers run, from lead conversion to closed-won, and the pipeline board is where our customers spend their working day.

This role is frontend-first. The hard problems here are interface problems: a drag-and-drop pipeline board that stays smooth with thousands of cards on screen, optimistic updates that roll back cleanly when a write fails, deal detail views assembled from arbitrary customer-defined custom fields, filters and saved views that hold up under real use, and keeping all of it coherent as several people move deals in the same pipeline at once. Getting this right is the difference between a CRM customers tolerate and one they trust.

You will own frontend features end-to-end in Vue.js, and you will go into the backend as the work requires — extending an API, shaping a response so the client does not have to over-fetch, adding an endpoint that serves the view you are building. You do not need to be a backend specialist; you do need to be unafraid of the server side and happy to work in it rather than filing a ticket. Senior engineers own the broader architecture and are there for design guidance and review.

What You Will Do:


    • Own frontend features across Opportunities in Vue.js — the pipeline board, deal detail views, stage and pipeline configuration, filters and saved views, bulk actions, and reporting surfaces

    • Build interactions that have to feel instant: drag-and-drop stage moves, inline edits, optimistic updates with clean rollback and clear error states when a write fails

    • Make large pipelines fast in the browser — virtualized and windowed lists, pagination and lazy loading, render and re-render cost, bundle size, and time to first meaningful paint on a board with thousands of deals

    • Design and maintain client-side state and data-fetching patterns (Pinia/Vuex, caching, invalidation) so the UI stays consistent without redundant round-trips

    • Handle concurrency in the interface: live updates when a teammate moves a deal, stale-data detection, and sensible conflict resolution

    • Render dynamic, customer-defined schemas — custom fields, custom objects, and per-workspace configuration — without special-casing every variation

    • Build reusable, well-composed components, and contribute to the shared design system rather than growing one-off UI

    • Work directly from designs, and push back with product and design where an interaction will not hold up in practice

    • Extend the backend where your feature needs it: adding or reshaping NestJS API endpoints, trimming over-fetching, and adjusting payloads for the view you are building

    • Write tests that matter — component and unit tests, plus end-to-end coverage of the flows customers cannot afford to have broken

    • Instrument the frontend: error tracking, real-user performance monitoring, and the event data needed to see how a feature is actually used

    • Care about accessibility, keyboard support, responsive layout, and cross-browser behavior as part of shipping, not as a follow-up

    • Take part in on-call for the surfaces you own, debug production issues, and contribute to postmortems

    • Write clear design docs for the features you own, and participate actively in design and code review

What You will Need:

    • 3+ years building and shipping production frontend applications

    • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, and depth in a component framework — Vue preferred, React fine if you are willing to work in Vue

    • Real experience with complex, stateful interfaces — not just forms and CRUD screens

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Director, Knowledge Management

College Board | Office of the CEO

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near College Board offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Type: This is a full-time position.

About the Team

The Office of the CEO (OCEO) is a small, high-leverage enterprise team that operates at the center of College Board. Working directly with the CEO, President, and senior leaders, OCEO strengthens and accelerates mission impact by ensuring the organization moves in a coherent, disciplined, and aligned way. The office brings together executive leadership support and enterprise execution, connecting strategy to action and enabling leaders to focus on what matters most for students.

Digital Workplace is a core function within OCEO focused on the systems, norms, and operating habits that enable modern execution in a distributed organization. The team is responsible for turning collaboration platforms and productivity tools into a connected digital workplace that supports clarity, transparency, and speed at scale. By establishing shared standards for how information is organized, how work is coordinated, and how leaders and teams collaborate day to day, Digital Workplace reduces friction, improves execution quality, and helps the organization operate as One College Board, regardless of location.

About the Opportunity

As Director, Knowledge Management, you will make sure College Board's staff intranet (myBoard) works as a reliable, trusted enterprise knowledge hub in an environment where information is constantly evolving, incomplete, and often competing for attention. In a complex, distributed organization, staff effectiveness depends not on having more information but on being able to quickly find, understand, and trust what matters most. This role exists to impose clarity where knowledge is inherently messy.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Digital Workplace within the Office of the CEO, you will own the vision, structure, and editorial quality of the staff intranet as the authoritative source of enterprise guidance. You will define how information is organized, written, curated, and maintained over time, using strong editorial judgment to clarify, synthesize, restructure, or retire content so staff can act with confidence rather than interpret ambiguity.

This role recognizes that knowledge does not live in a single place. You will design intentional information flows across channels, determining what belongs on the staff intranet, what should be curated or summarized elsewhere, and how systems, metadata, and automation can reduce manual maintenance and improve discoverability. Rather than relying on constant human intervention, you will use structure, standards, and tooling to make information easier to keep current and easier to find.

Your work will require navigating real tradeoffs: enterprise consistency versus local context, speed versus precision, and clarity versus completeness. During moments of organizational, policy, or tool change, your leadership will be especially critical, helping staff orient quickly by ensuring guidance is coherent, clearly written, and surfaced in predictable ways.

Our ideal candidate is a systems thinker with a strong editorial eye who is comfortable operating in ambiguity. You understand that knowledge management is never finished, and you bring the judgment, discipline, and curiosity required to continually improve how information supports execution at scale.

In this role, you will

Enterprise Intranet Vision, Architecture, and Standards (30%)

  • Define and steward the enterprise vision for the staff intranet as the authoritative source of enterprise guidance.

  • Own the staff intranet's information architecture, including navigation, metadata, templates, page types, and structural standards that improve findability and usability.

  • Establish clear expectations for what content belongs to the staff intranet versus other channels, and how the staff intranet functions as the system of record.

  • Continuously evolve intranet structures based on how staff actually seek, interpret, and use information.

Content Quality and Clarity (25%)

  • Serve as the editorial owner for the staff intranet, ensuring enterprise guidance is clear, concise, well-structured, and written for a staff audience.

  • Establish and enforce editorial and content standards, including tone, structure, and clarity thresholds for enterprise-wide content.

  • Edit, synthesize, restructure, or retire high-impact enterprise content to resolve ambiguity, duplication, or inconsistency.

  • Ensure staff-facing content answers core execution questions: What is this? Who does it apply to? What do I need to do? Where do I go next?

Content Governance, Ownership, and Sustainability (20%)

  • Partner with Engagement and Reach (communications), Enterprise Rhythm, and other key stakeholders to execute the enterprise content calendar and push essential messages to the right audiences.

  • Establish and maintain governance for content ownership, review cycles, and quality standards for the staff intranet.

  • Clarify what information is canonical, who owns it, and how currency is maintained over time.

  • Partner with content owners across the enterprise to improve the quality and sustainability of guidance, without turning the staff intranet into a dumping ground.

  • Navigate competing priorities and incomplete information using judgment rather than rigid process.

Channel Strategy, Curation, and Information Flow (15%)

  • Design intentional information flows across enterprise channels, including the staff intranet, collaboration tools, announcements, and shared workspaces.

  • Define when to centralize, curate, summarize, cross-link, or automate rather than duplicate content.

  • Reduce cognitive load on staff by ensuring information appears in the right place, at the right time, in the right form.

  • Use metadata, tagging, and system features to improve discovery, target specific audiences, and reduce manual content maintenance.

Technology Partnership, Automation, and Continuous Improvement (10%)

  • Partner with Technology on platform configuration, integrations, and performance, while retaining business ownership of staff intranet information structure, standards, and editorial quality.

  • Use system capabilities and automation to support content currency, governance, and discovery over time.

  • Use feedback, search behavior, and usage signals to identify gaps and improve staff intranet effectiveness.

  • Iterate structures and standards as organizational needs, tools, and priorities evolve.

About You

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in roles spanning intranet leadership, information architecture, content strategy, digital workplace, knowledge systems, or enterprise platforms in complex organizations.

  • Demonstrated ability to design and steward enterprise knowledge hubs that staff actually use and trust, balancing structure, usability, and real-world constraints.

  • Strong editorial judgment and writing skills, with experience clarifying, synthesizing, and polishing complex guidance so it is understandable and actionable for a staff audience.

  • Experience establishing and enforcing editorial and content standards, including tone, structure, page types, and quality thresholds, without turning governance into bureaucracy.

  • Comfort operating in messy, evolving information environments, where guidance is incomplete, competing, or changing, and where judgment matters more than rigid process.

  • Fluency designing information flows across multiple channels, with a clear sense of when to centralize, curate, summarize, cross-link, or retire content rather than duplicate it.

  • Experience using systems, metadata, audience targeting, and automation to improve information discovery, reduce manual maintenance, and support content currency over time.

  • A track record of partnering with senior leaders and content owners, influencing without formal authority, and navigating competing priorities.

  • Strong collaboration skills working alongside Technology partners while retaining clear business ownership of standards and quality.

  • A systems mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to zoom between strategic intent and hands-on execution.

  • A commitment to College Board's mission and to improving staff effectiveness in service of students.

  • Ability to travel2-4times a year on behalf of College Board business

All positions at College Board require

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work.

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions, and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

.

  • Escalate critical issues to the appropriate internal channel, ensuring timely response and testing and communicating the resolution
  • Report bugs to our Engineering teams, as well as helping to prioritize fixes to ensure customer satisfaction
  • Clearly communicate with customers and other internal teams about issues impacting their service
  • Effectively verify that issues have been resolved

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, such as Product Management, Support, and R&D to translate customer business needs and product feedback into new solutions
  • Work on reporting and knowledge base documentation

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. Location

Travel

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

jobs.title: Senior Server/Cloud Engineer
jobs.excerpt: VIATEQ is looking for a Senior Server/Cloud Engineerto support our Prime contractor and government customer in Washington, DC.
jobs.description:
VIATEQ is looking for a Senior Server/Cloud Engineerto support our Prime contractor and government customer in Washington, DC. The position is remote and requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.

We are seeking a Senior Server / Cloud Engineer with a minimum of 8 years of experience to design, deploy, and support enterprise server and cloud infrastructure for a federal civilian customer undergoing active data center consolidation and cloud modernization. The ideal candidate has hands-on expertise in administering Windows Server and Linux environments at enterprise scale and leading migration of on-premises workloads to AWS, including GovCloud. Experience with VMware-based virtualization and infrastructure-as-code is strongly preferred.

The Senior Server / Cloud Engineer will be responsible for designing, deploying, and administering enterprise server and cloud infrastructure, leading migration of legacy on-premises workloads to AWS GovCloud, and supporting the customer's active data center consolidation initiative.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and administer Windows Server and Linux (RHEL/CentOS) systems supporting enterprise applications and services.

  • Lead migration of legacy, on-premises data center workloads to AWS GovCloud as part of the customer's data center exit initiative, including four planned data center consolidations.

  • Administer VMware vSphere/vCenter environments, including capacity planning, patching, and lifecycle management of virtual infrastructure.

  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and configuration management (e.g., Ansible) for repeatable, auditable deployments.

  • Support Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and identity/access management across hybrid environments.

  • Partner with security engineering to remediate vulnerabilities, apply STIG/hardening baselines, and support continuous monitoring (ConMon) activities.

  • Participate in the design and testing of business disaster continuity and recovery (BDCR) solutions for critical financial and mission systems.

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks for supported systems.

  • Provide Tier 3 escalation support and participate in an on-call rotation for production incidents.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in server and/or cloud engineering roles
  • Expert-level administration of Windows Server and Linux operating systems in an enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience migrating workloads to AWS (GovCloud experience strongly preferred)
  • Experience with VMware virtualization (vSphere/vCenter) at enterprise scale
  • Experience with Containers/Kubernetes, FinOps/cost-optimization and Zero Trust principals.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tooling (Terraform, Ansible, or similar)

  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, Active Directory, and identity/access management fundamentals

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce technical documentation and diagrams

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

  • Ability to obtain public trust clearance

Preferred Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience working in a federal government IT environment

  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate

  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or equivalent

  • Experience with data center exit/consolidation projects on a federal contract

  • Experience supporting financial, loan-servicing, or capital-access application environments

  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53 controls and FedRAMP-authorized cloud services

Compensation Range:

$145,000 – 165,000. This represents the typical compensation range for this position based on experience, location, and other factors.

About VIATEQ

VIATEQ is a proactive provider of collaborative solutions for federal government agencies. Our collaborative service framework and flexibility allow employees, customers, and business partners to work together successfully anywhere, anytime. VIATEQ’s service areas also allow government agencies to respond to competitive pressures and achieve new performance levels.

VIATEQ offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, 12 paid federal holidays, flexible spending accounts, and a professional development reimbursement.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

VIATEQ provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.description:
About Binance
Binance is the global leading blockchain ecosystem, operating the world's largest digital asset trading platform by volume, serving over 300 million users across 100+ countries and regions. We are committed to building a more open financial ecosystem and improving global access to financial services.

Binance is continuously building stock and related financial market products for global users. The relevant data will serve user-facing stock products and Binance AI business scenarios. We are seeking professionals with stock market experience to jointly build reliable, scalable data and financial AI capabilities.

Role Overview
You will participate in building the core data foundation for Binance's stock and related financial market businesses, responsible for the full pipeline from data source discovery, evaluation, ingestion, and integration to unified modeling, real-time processing, quality governance, and data services. Beyond completing defined integrations, we expect you to leverage industry expertise to continuously identify better data sources and technical solutions, enabling new markets, products, and data to serve trading products and AI quickly and reliably.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research, technical evaluation, ingestion, integration, cleansing, standardization, computation, storage, and servicing of financial market data, covering securities master data, real-time and historical market data, fundamentals, corporate actions, indices, and business-required product and risk data; responsible for source ingestion, raw retention, and stable delivery to knowledge engineering pipelines for content-type data such as announcements, news, and research reports.
  • Design scalable unified data models and integration frameworks, handling different markets' trading calendars, time zones, currencies, security identifiers, listing relationships, lifecycles, and data corrections, supporting rapid onboarding of new markets and sources.
  • Build batch-stream unified data pipelines centered on Flink, continuously optimizing latency, throughput, query performance, stability, and cost, while supporting consumer trading products, research analysis, and AI scenarios.
  • Establish data quality and service level frameworks, taking responsibility for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and traceability; build automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, monitoring and alerting, raw data replay, backfill, and fault recovery capabilities.
  • Evaluate different sources (vendors, exchanges, APIs, file feeds, compliance collection) for coverage, quality, stability, revision mechanisms, and technical fit; collaborate with product, procurement, legal, and compliance teams to clarify usage, display, derivative, retention, and redistribution boundaries; drive rational primary/backup source strategies and alternatives.
  • Define data semantics, metric definitions, and service contracts jointly with trading product, data platform, AI engineering, and algorithm teams, ensuring consistent and reliable usage of the same stock facts across different products.
  • Drive data engineering efficiency and technical quality improvements, including metadata, data lineage, automated testing, CI/CD, task orchestration, capacity governance, and AI-assisted development.

Requirements

  • Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field; 5+ years of experience in data development, big data, or data platforms.
  • Familiar with stock markets and the investor research and decision-making workflow; understand trading mechanisms, market data, fundamentals and financial reports, corporate actions, valuation, and major market events; able to explain the complete pipeline of at least one type of financial data from source to user-facing product and key quality risks.
  • Proficient in SQL and Flink, with experience in large-scale real-time data processing, performance tuning, stability governance, and production issue troubleshooting.
  • Proficient in at least one of Java, Scala, or Python; familiar with Kafka, Spark, and ClickHouse, Doris, HBase, Elasticsearch, or other distributed storage and analytics technologies.
  • Familiar with data modeling, task scheduling, metadata, data lineage, data governance, and service levels; able to independently resolve cross-system data consistency issues.
  • High standards for data quality; able to design reproducible reconciliation, anomaly detection, backfill, and degradation strategies — not just completing data development tasks.
  • Experience with data source selection or production ingestion; able to articulate trade-offs between build vs. buy, multi-source verification, vendor dependency, and alternative solutions.
  • Strong business understanding and cross-team collaboration skills; able to translate trading, risk, research, or AI problems into clear data models and data contracts.

    • Bonus

  • Experience with stock data at brokerages, market data services, financial data, wealth management, or fintech platforms.
  • Familiarity with US stock market structure, trading calendars, pre/post-market sessions, corporate actions, and adjustment rules; experience with other stock markets also a plus.
  • Data experience with stock-related derivatives, ETFs, indices, or tokenized products.
  • Experience building low-latency market data pipelines, securities master data platforms, multi-market data models, quantitative research platforms, or large-scale backtesting data systems.
  • Experience with data anomaly detection, knowledge graphs, financial entity alignment, or building high-quality financial datasets for LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

Working at Binance

• Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow and offers excellent career development opportunities
• Work alongside diverse, world-class talent in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless
• Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects
• Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure
• Competitive salary and benefits
• Flexible working hours, remote-first, and casual work attire

Solutions Integration

The Director, Product Management – Life Cycle Assessment is responsible for the vision, strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Assent’s LCA capabilities. This leader translates customer needs, life cycle assessment methodologies, evolving standards, market opportunities, and technical constraints into scalable B2B SaaS solutions.

This individual will lead and develop a team of Product Managers and work closely with sustainability and LCA subject-matter experts, Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. The Director will ensure that product decisions balance scientific credibility, customer usability, technical feasibility, commercial value, and the transparency and traceability required for defensible environmental information. This includes identifying opportunities to responsibly apply AI and machine learning to improve data collection, classification, calculation workflows, insight generation, and customer decision-making, while maintaining appropriate transparency, validation, human oversight, and scientific integrity.

The successful candidate combines strong product leadership with practical LCA knowledge, enabling them to challenge methodology decisions and communicate credibly with practitioners and customers.

Key Requirements & Responsibilities

  • Define the LCA product portfolio strategy, objectives, and investment priorities in alignment with Assent’s corporate strategy, customer needs, and commercial growth objectives
  • Own the success of Assent’s LCA solution, including customer value, adoption, commercial performance, methodological credibility, and integration with Assent’s broader platform
  • Build strategic relationships with customers, LCA practitioners, consultants, data providers, and industry partners to generate market insight, anticipate emerging needs, validate product priorities, and help shape product strategy and roadmap decisions
  • Ensure LCA capabilities provide appropriate calculation transparency, data lineage, source attribution, version control, quality indicators, and audit trails so that customers can understand and substantiate their results
  • Provide product leadership across end-to-end delivery, partnering with Engineering and Quality Assurance to ensure releases are timely, high-quality, and aligned with customer needs, product strategy, and business objectives
  • Define and monitor product success measures, including customer adoption, time to value, data coverage and quality, calculation completion, customer confidence, retention, expansion, and commercial performance
  • Monitor relevant LCA standards, methodologies, regulatory requirements, and market developments; assess their implications and translate them into product strategy, data requirements, roadmap priorities, and scalable software capabilities
  • Develop and evaluate business cases for LCA product investments using customer evidence, competitive analysis, data and methodology dependencies, delivery costs, commercial opportunities, and product risks
  • In collaboration with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, establish go-to-market strategy for new products, including pricing, positioning and growth plans
