jobs.title: Freelance Agent Evaluation Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

jobs.title: Alliances Field Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.

Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.

We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.

We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical’s technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners’ teams to promote Canonical products and solutions

If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.

What we are looking for in you

  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.excerpt: Reports to: Senior Manager, Security Operations Center Location: Remote AustraliaCompensation Range: $110,000 to $140,000 AUD base plus bonus and equity What We Do:Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations.
jobs.description:
Reports to: Senior Manager, Security Operations Center

Location: Remote Australia

Compensation Range: $110,000 to $140,000 AUD base plus bonus and equity

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 14M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

What You’ll Do:

You’re a hands-on SOC Analyst who thrives on detecting and responding to cybercrime. You’ll triage Active Hands-On Keyboard intrusions, track attackers through networks, and help remove them before they achieve their objectives. You’ll contextualise endpoint telemetry, analyse logs, leverage forensic artifacts, and understand malware to uncover the full scope of an intrusion.

You give a $ht about protecting customers and improving how the team operates, taking ownership of investigations and acting on the information available. You bring Warrior Spirit to complex incidents, staying resilient and composed under pressure. You are Outcome-Obsessed, measuring your work by the threats contained, customers protected, and actionable remediation delivered. Alongside alert triage and intrusion response, you’ll support sales, collaborate with Product to shape Huntress’ MDR service and platform, and have opportunities to contribute across Incident Response, Security Operations, Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering. We’ll also support you in sharing your work through blogs, conference talks, webinars, and research publications that build your personal brand and the broader security community.

You’ll need to be available to work one of the following shifts:

  • Western Australia: Monday to Friday, 8:00 am - 4:00 pm AWST
  • East Coast: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm AEST
  • East Coast: Tuesday to Friday, 8:00 am - 6:00 pm AEST

Responsibilities:

  • Triage, investigate, respond to, and remediate alerts generated by the Huntress platform.
  • Review EDR/SIEM telemetry, log sources, and forensic artifacts to determine the root cause of attacks where possible and provide the remediation needed to remove the threat.
  • Perform dynamic analysis of malware when required to extract indicators of compromise or determine a file’s malicious intent.
  • Contribute to and refine detection capabilities and queue hygiene through crafting and tuning signals to address emerging threats.
  • Investigate activity in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace and deliver actionable remediation advice for compromised tenants.
  • Continue to grow your skills and knowledge through real-world intrusion data, paid training opportunities, and responsible use of AI tools to support research, summarise findings, and accelerate routine analysis while validating outputs.
  • Support customer success by assisting our SOC Support team with customer/partner escalations related to threat-related and SOC-relevant questions.
  • Help through partnering with Product and Engineering Teams to continue to evolve Human Led Agentic workflows

What You Bring To The Team:

  • You have 2+ years of experience in SOC, Incident Response, Managed Detection and Response, or Digital Forensics roles.
  • You have demonstrated experience with at least one of Windows, Linux, or macOS, including attack surfaces, malware analysis, and basic threat actor tools and techniques.
  • You understand common system administration skills and how threat actors abuse them to achieve their goals, including Active Directory, PowerShell, Group Policy, and local account creation.
  • You are familiar with the techniques and tactics in MITRE ATT&CK, including credential dumping, lateral movement, persistence mechanisms, and exfiltration techniques.
  • You have a working knowledge of core networking concepts, including common ports and protocols, NAT, public and private IP addresses, and VLANs.
  • You have a passion for forensics and enjoy digging into logs, processes, and artifacts to understand intrusions and outmaneuver attackers.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, simplify complex technical findings for diverse audiences, and demonstrate self-guided learning that keeps your skills current.
  • You use AI to work faster and smarter in day-to-day security analysis, applying sound judgment and validating its output before acting on it.
  • You enjoy working with a fun, supportive team, bring a genuine team-player mindset, and help deliver great outcomes with a smile, a laugh, and a dash of witty (but accurate) memes.
  • A desire to hold your manager accountable for delivering ice cream at the Australian Security Offsite.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote work
  • At least one annual trip to the US for Summer Summit, with additional local events in Australia!
  • New starter home office set up reimbursement ($800 AUD)
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave for both primary and secondary carers
  • Monthly digital allowance for personal phone and internet costs ($185 AUD)
  • Monthly home office tech stipend to upgrade or replace equipment ($40 AUD)
  • Subsidised private health insurance through our preferred provider
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

People from all culturally diverse backgrounds, including Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander Peoples, are encouraged to apply.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to . Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Financial Partnerships team sits within the Global Partnerships organization and is foundational to Stripe’s success. Our team is responsible for developing and managing Stripe’s relationships with global and regional banks, card networks, and money movement product partners that enable Stripe’s product strategy and deliver new capabilities to Stripe users.

Our team executes high-impact, cross-functional product partnership initiatives across existing products and early-stage financial products further up the stack. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and are essential to offering products used by millions of Stripe users.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for someone to develop and execute high-impact initiatives and strategies with new and existing AMER bank partners. You’ll work closely with Product to support Stripe’s Treasury, Issuing, Capital, and Crypto businesses. This includes product development, defining and aligning on partner requirements, leading partner relationships to execute on those requirements, and negotiating, signing, and managing relationships with global partners to support Stripe’s growing MaaS product line.

The role requires close coordination with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and Risk, as well as with partners’ senior executives.

Responsibilities

  • Manage Stripe’s critical bank partner relationships, with a focus on executing joint initiatives and launching new offerings that benefit Stripe users.
  • Ensure best-in-class, methodical partner and deal management rooted in milestone definition, a thoughtful and documented negotiation approach, and alignment on opportunities of mutual interest.
  • Use industry knowledge to craft partnership and product strategies, and execute deals and initiatives that support Stripe’s strategy.
  • Gather input from and coordinate with internal cross-functional stakeholders, including Risk, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Treasury, to create and execute partner and related product strategies.
  • Identify partner stakeholders who will champion Stripe, educate them about Stripe’s value proposition, and build alignment between Stripe and partners’ executive teams.
  • Manage strategic planning, negotiation, and expansion activities with key partners.
  • Manage multiple stakeholders with varying priorities, and drive creative solutions and commitment to shared goals.
  • Use strategic and product creativity to design and develop new models for money movement, as well as extensions of Treasury, Issuing, Capital, and Crypto use cases for Stripe’s direct and platform users.
  • Exhibit an operationally focused mindset, with the ability to lead teams through complex relationship-management activities by setting a clear vision and running tight processes.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, corporate development, or a related field, including experience in partner management or business development with banking institutions at payment service providers or fintech companies enabling pay-in, pay-out, stored-value, or cross-border money movement experiences.
  • Advanced knowledge of the banking and clearing landscape across multiple geographies, with a specific focus on transaction banking, e-money, safeguarding, multi-currency, and cross-border payments.
  • Experience building proprietary global issuing, collection, and payout networks is ideal.
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial deals with bank partners, including scaling those deals across multiple partners.
  • Thorough understanding of fintech business models and associated best practices for compliance and risk management.
  • A proven track record of working in a product-centric environment with significant internal and external dependencies across Product, Engineering, Legal, Sales, Risk, and Compliance.
  • Deep experience executing industry-wide partnership strategies to build innovative product experiences and go-to-market models.
  • Strong negotiation skills and ambition about what Stripe should pursue with partners, and how Stripe creates value and differentiation.
  • An operationally focused mindset, with the ability to see challenging deals through to success well beyond signing. Experience leading teams through execution using planning, metrics, and organizational structures.
  • A mindset focused on contributing to the success of the team and company beyond individual goals and objectives.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience at fintech companies that build payment and card-issuing programs or stablecoin-linked card programs.
  • Experience developing partnership strategy across multiple markets or partner types.
  • Experience representing a company with industry groups, at conferences, or with senior external executives.
  • Experience mentoring or guiding peers on partnership strategy, complex negotiations, or cross-functional execution.

CLEAR Global is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to having a diverse team where individuals of all backgrounds collaborate and learn from one another. We believe we can be most effective with diverse experience and expertise in our team. We recruit on merit, actively seek diverse applicant pools, and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, marital or parental status, or sexual orientation, and welcome all types of diversity.

Background

CLEAR Global is powered by a global community of over 200,000 linguists, who give their time and skills to help people access information in the language they understand. Keeping this community informed, connected, and engaged is essential to our work. This happens through online events, ongoing conversations on our Discourse platform, and community-led projects where members work together on shared tasks.

The role

The Community Engagement Intern will help keep CLEAR Global's community active, connected, and well supported. This includes helping to plan and run online events, supporting and moderating conversations on the Discourse platform, and helping community members work together on collaborative projects. The role is well suited to someone who enjoys bringing people together, keeping things organized, and helping a community feel welcoming and well run.

This internship offers hands-on experience in community management within an international nonprofit, and the chance to build practical skills in event planning, online moderation, and community coordination.

Responsibilities

  • Help manage and develop our Discourse community space: Take an active role in the day-to-day management of the platform, including creating and organizing categories, channels and topics, supporting basic administration, and helping improve the space as the community grows.
  • Keep the community active and engaged: Proactively start and follow up on conversations, identify opportunities for new discussions, and encourage members to contribute, share experiences, and connect with each other.
  • Moderate community conversations: Help keep discussions constructive, inclusive, and respectful, and raise inappropriate content or more sensitive issues with the wider team when needed.
  • Support community members: Help members use and navigate Discourse, respond to questions, and support basic troubleshooting where needed.
  • Support community-led projects: Help set up and coordinate projects where community members work together on shared activities, using platforms such as Discourse and Slack, and regularly follow up with contributors to maintain momentum.
  • Help plan online events: Support the planning of community events, including identifying topics and formats, finding and coordinating speakers, and connecting events with wider community activities.
  • Manage event logistics: Support scheduling, registration, participant communications, preparation, and practical tasks during online events.
  • Track feedback and engagement: Gather feedback and maintain simple records of participation, engagement, and results to help improve future community activities.
  • Provide coordination and administrative support: Help maintain documents, trackers, calendars, and follow-up actions so that community activities stay organized and on track.
  • Other tasks: Take on other community engagement tasks as needed and represent CLEAR Global appropriately throughout the internship.
  • Represent CLEAR Global well: Act in the best interests of the organization throughout the internship.

These roles and responsibilities are approximate and may change over time.

Qualifications

  • Current graduate student at the Middlebury Institute of International Studies (MIIS),
  • An interest in community management, events, or online engagement (previous experience is not required, but is a plus);
  • Comfortable communicating with a wide range of people online;
  • Good organizational skills, and comfortable managing a few tasks at once;
  • Comfortable learning new tools and software; training and support will be provided.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong written and spoken English.

Requirements

This position is well suited to someone starting out in community management or event coordination. The right person is friendly, organized, and enjoys helping people connect. They should agree with CLEAR Global's basic beliefs and values, and be able to work remotely while staying in regular contact with the Senior Community Officer and the wider team.

  • Self-starter;
  • Strong organizational skills;
  • Analytical thinker able to transform ideas into tangible actions;
  • Understands that communication in the right language is key to improved humanitarian response;
  • Team player, collaborative, adaptable and self-motivated;
  • Interest in acquiring translation project management experience;
  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn new skills quickly;
  • Attention to detail.

About CLEAR Global

CLEAR Global exists to help people get vital information, and be heard, whatever language they speak. We believe that everyone has the right to give and receive information in a language and format they understand. We work with nonprofit partners and a global community of language professionals to build local language translation capacity, and raise awareness of language barriers. Our network of over 200,000 community members translate millions of words of life-saving and life-changing information a year.

Core values

CLEAR Global employees and volunteers are people who believe passionately about the value of this work and take personal responsibility for achieving the mission. CLEAR Global’s mission and organizational spirit embody the core values established in its strategic framework:

  • Excellence: As the leading voice for communicating humanitarian information in the right language, CLEAR Global is a leader in the translation industry and in the non-profit sector.
  • Integrity: CLEAR Global believes that every person, whether it’s the people who we serve, our volunteers or our staff, has value, deserves respect and has inherent dignity.
  • Empowerment: CLEAR Global believes in using language to empower people around the world to control their own development and destiny.
  • Innovation: CLEAR Global recognizes and celebrates the power of innovation to address humanitarian and crisis issues around the world.
  • Sustainability: CLEAR Global recognizes that meeting our mission necessitates establishment and maintenance of a solid financial and organizational infrastructure.
  • Tolerance: Our staff and volunteers are highly knowledgeable and skilled; value each other, our partner and our recipients; create a supportive work environment; and conduct themselves professionally at all times.

CLEAR Global may re-advertise the vacancy, cancel the recruitment, offer an appointment with a modified job description or for a different duration at its discretion.

jobs.description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov

Remote · Full-time contractor

The Quick Version

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

The details

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

  • Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
  • Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
  • Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
  • Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
  • The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
  • Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? 😛Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

  • Exceptional Enthusiasm
  • Extremely Creative Energy
  • You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
  • You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
  • AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
  • Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
  • Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
  • B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

  1. Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
  2. There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

Requirements

IMPORTANT

  • Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
  • Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Director, FSAAS Strategic Account Lead

Location: Remote | USA, Canada

Reports to: Vice President, Financial Services Sales

Employment Type: Full-time

This is a new vacancy

About the Role:

The Senior Director, FSAAS Strategic Account Lead (Producing), is a strategic sales leader responsible for driving direct revenue while collaborating with a focused team of experienced specialist sellers and Customer Success professionals. This role balances personal selling, cross-functional coordination, and executive-level client engagement, with an emphasis on high-value opportunities within a defined portfolio of strategic accounts.

This position is ideal for a proven enterprise seller with strong executive engagement and account orchestration skills, as well as a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes. The Senior Director, FSAAS Strategic Account Lead (Producing), supports JD Power's largest and most strategic financial services customers while serving as a hands-on contributor to FSAAS bookings growth, retention, and overall client success.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

In this role, you will directly drive bookings performance while partnering with a team of specialist sellers focused on long-term customer success and business growth. Your involvement in strategic opportunities will accelerate revenue growth, model best-in-class enterprise selling practices, and support your specialist colleagues through effective account planning and collaboration. You will also play a critical role in driving customer retention, expanding existing relationships, and maintaining exceptional levels of customer satisfaction.

What You'll Be Doing in This Role:

Direct Revenue Generation

  • Own an individual sales quota focused on high-value new business and expansion opportunities.
  • Drive cross-sell and upsell growth within existing customer accounts.
  • Lead complex, strategic sales cycles involving senior customer stakeholders and executives.
  • Partner with Specialist Sellers, Customer Solutions, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to deliver compelling customer outcomes.

Strategic Account Leadership & Coordination

  • Own and lead the overall account strategy for assigned strategic clients.
  • Partner with an experienced team of specialist sellers representing the FSAAS product portfolio within the financial services segment.
  • Establish priorities, coordinate pursuits, and drive alignment across account teams and opportunities.
  • Facilitate collaboration, information sharing, and execution across internal stakeholders.

Customer Engagement & Executive Relationships

  • Develop and execute comprehensive account plans aligned to customer business objectives and growth priorities.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across customer business, operations, product, and procurement organizations.
  • Conduct regular strategic business reviews with senior client stakeholders.
  • Coordinate executive engagement opportunities between customer leadership teams and JD Power executives.

Cross-Functional & Peer Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of alignment across internal JD Power stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with specialist sellers and functional partners.
  • Contribute market insights and customer feedback to strategy, product development, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities, emerging customer needs, and growth areas across assigned accounts.

Time Allocation (Guiding Principle)

  • Majority of time: Direct selling and customer engagement.
  • Meaningful portion: Strategic account planning, team coordination, and peer collaboration.
  • Remaining time: Partnering with Customer Success, Customer Solutions, and Product teams to share market intelligence and develop integrated customer solutions.

Metrics & Measures of Success

·Achievement of individual sales quota.

  • Achievement of account Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) target.
  • Quality, progression, and velocity of strategic opportunities.
  • Contribution to overall bookings growth and deal success through collaboration with specialist sellers.
  • Effectiveness of account coordination and deal execution.
  • Strength of executive relationships across assigned customer accounts.
  • Customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction outcomes.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience with a proven track record of success.
  • Experience selling complex solutions to senior decision-makers and executive stakeholders in financial services.
  • Strong business acumen and knowledge of the financial services industry.
  • Ability to balance individual performance with effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and executive presence skills.

Up to 20-30% travel based.

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a Total Target Compensation (TTC) range of $275,000 - $300,000 CAD / $280,000 - $320,000 USDper year, inclusive of base salary and target incentive opportunity. This position has uncapped earnings potential based upon sales commission plan achievement. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s compensation within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

  • We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.
  • We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.
  • We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.
  • We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.
  • We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation:$2,500–$3,500 USD/month
Experience:4–6+ years
Schedule: Full-Time | Strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time required
Industry: Investment Management / Alternative Investments
Department: Go-To-Market / Growth

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for sophisticated investors, financial advisory firms, and multi-family offices.

The firm combines deep investment expertise with a technology-driven approach and is entering its next stage of growth. As its investment platform and partnerships expand, the company is building a scalable go-to-market engine to generate demand, strengthen its market presence, and support continued growth.

About the Role

We are looking for an Agentic GTM Lead who combines real engineering ability, commercial instinct, demand-generation experience, and financial market knowledge.

This is not a traditional marketing role, and it is not a pure engineering role.

You will build and own the systems that generate demand across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and AI-powered automation. You will connect the technical infrastructure behind these channels with measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified interest, booked meetings, and pipeline.

Most importantly, you bring the ideas.

You will not be handed a complete GTM playbook to execute. You are expected to identify new demand-generation opportunities, launch multiple experiments simultaneously, measure what works, quickly eliminate what does not, and scale the strategies that produce results.

This is a highly autonomous, hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys moving from an idea to a working system and then proving its commercial impact with data.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to build a sophisticated GTM engine from the ground up within a growing investment management business.

You will have significant ownership over how demand is created, measured, automated, and scaled.

You will be able to:

  • Build rather than simply manage existing marketing systems

  • Experiment across multiple acquisition channels

  • Apply AI and agentic workflows to real commercial problems

  • Connect engineering directly to pipeline and revenue

  • Develop systems that automate repetitive GTM work

  • Shape the company's content, social, outbound, and digital presence

  • Work with sophisticated financial products and audiences

What You'll Do

Build and Scale the GTM Engine

  • Develop new demand-generation ideas, channels, and experiments

  • Build systems across outbound, content, social, SEO/GEO, email, and website acquisition

  • Turn successful experiments into repeatable and scalable growth systems

  • Rapidly stop or redesign initiatives that are not producing measurable results

  • Connect GTM infrastructure directly to qualified interest, meetings, pipeline, and revenue

Build Technical GTM Infrastructure

  • Work hands-on with APIs, SQL, Python and/or JavaScript

  • Build integrations between data sources, automation platforms, CRMs, and GTM systems

  • Create workflows using tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, and CRM platforms

  • Design lead enrichment, account scoring, personalization, sequencing, routing, and attribution systems

  • Build solutions rather than relying exclusively on no-code configuration

Build AI & Agentic Workflows

  • Design and deploy workflows using LLMs and AI agents

  • Automate research, content development, personalization, lead enrichment, and routing

  • Identify repetitive GTM processes that can be automated or augmented with AI

  • Build scalable systems that allow a small team to operate with significantly greater leverage

Own Demand Generation

  • Build and optimize outbound programs based on signals, data, and a clearly defined ICP

  • Develop demand through outbound, SEO/GEO, content, social, and other acquisition channels

  • Build measurable programs that generate qualified interest and booked meetings

  • Continuously test messaging, audiences, channels, landing pages, and sequences

Build the Content & Social Engine

  • Develop systems for producing and distributing podcasts, videos, webinars, social content, and thought leadership

  • Repurpose long-form content into multiple channel-specific assets

  • Build consistent visibility across platforms such as LinkedIn and X/Twitter

  • Help establish a credible voice for a sophisticated investment and wealth-management audience

Experiment & Measure

  • Run multiple experiments simultaneously rather than testing one channel at a time

  • Conduct structured A/B testing across messaging, channels, landing pages, and sequences

  • Build dashboards for demand generation, attribution, and pipeline contribution

  • Use evidence and commercial results to determine what gets scaled, changed, or eliminated

Required Qualifications

  • 4–6+ years of relevant experience across growth engineering, GTM engineering, demand generation, growth marketing, or related roles

  • Proven ability to generate original demand-generation ideas and independently turn them into experiments

  • Demonstrated demand-generation results through outbound, content, SEO/GEO, social, or similar channels

  • Ability to provide specific metrics or examples showing how your work generated leads, booked meetings, pipeline, or revenue

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability with APIs and SQL

  • Proficiency with at least one scripting language, preferably Python or JavaScript

  • Experience with automation platforms such as Clay, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

  • Hands-on experience working with CRM systems, integrations, data, and automation

  • Practical experience building with LLMs and AI/agent workflows

  • Strong commercial instinct and ability to connect technical builds to measurable business outcomes

  • Professional experience or strong working knowledge of finance, investing, asset management, or investment management

  • Strong experimentation and A/B testing mindset

  • Ability to build and own initiatives from 0 to 1

  • Strong design and UX judgment

  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment

  • Strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct professional experience in asset management or investment management

  • Experience with alternative investments and/or hedge funds

  • Strong personal or professional interest in financial markets and investing

  • Experience building a GTM, growth, or demand-generation function from scratch

  • Experience with data warehouses or analytics infrastructure such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt

  • Experience with attribution modeling

  • CFA, MBA, or other relevant finance/business education is a plus

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be based on your ability to create a measurable and scalable demand engine.

Key outcomes include:

  • A growing stream of qualified interest and booked meetings attributable to your GTM systems

  • Successful demand-generation experiments that can be scaled into repeatable programs

  • AI-powered and signal-based outbound systems actively generating opportunities

  • Consistent content and social distribution with measurable audience growth

  • Reliable measurement of demand and pipeline contribution

  • A continuous experimentation system that clearly identifies what should be scaled and what should be stopped

  • Existing GTM activities transformed into more automated, repeatable, and efficient systems

Why Join Us

You will join an environment where ideas are evaluated on merit, experimentation is encouraged, and ownership matters.

You will have the autonomy to determine how to reach the goal while being accountable for measurable outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who prefers building, shipping, measuring, and improving over spending months developing theoretical strategies.

If you are equally comfortable discussing APIs, AI agents, pipeline generation, A/B testing, and investment markets, this role offers the opportunity to bring those skills together in one highly impactful position.

Important Notes

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

  • Candidates must be able to maintain strong overlap with U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific demand-generation results and metrics from previous roles.

  • This is a hands-on builder position. Candidates whose experience is primarily managing agencies, teams, or pre-built marketing systems without directly building GTM infrastructure may not be the right fit.

  • Experience or strong knowledge of investment management, asset management, alternative investments, or related financial markets is important for success in this role.

This is a highly specialized role dedicated to the TikTok ecosystem, with a strong focus on maximizing Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) through Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, Live Shopping Ads, affiliate content, and TikTok Shop's native commerce tools.

The ideal candidate combines advanced paid media expertise with a deep understanding of how consumers discover and purchase products through TikTok. You should be comfortable managing significant advertising budgets, analyzing performance data, identifying winning creative quickly, and making real-time optimization decisions.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of performance marketing, social commerce, creative experimentation, and emerging technology.

You will have direct exposure to high-growth eCommerce brands and significant advertising budgets while helping shape TikTok Shop strategies in a fast-moving environment where creative thinking, analytical decision-making, and speed to market are critical.

What You’ll Do

TikTok Shop Media Buying

  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize Video Shopping Ads (VSA) and Product Shopping Ads (PSA) within TikTok Ads Manager.

  • Develop paid media strategies designed to increase TikTok Shop GMV while maintaining brand-specific profitability targets.

  • Continuously optimize campaign structures, bidding strategies, audiences, budgets, and creative performance.

Livestream & Social Commerce Strategy

  • Manage real-time bidding and traffic orchestration for Live Shopping Ads (LSA) during key brand events.

  • Monitor live campaign performance and make rapid adjustments based on traffic, conversion, inventory, and promotional activity.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the relationship between paid media and organic TikTok Shop activity.

Affiliate & Creator Scaling

  • Identify high-performing affiliate content through the TikTok Shop Affiliate Center.

  • Scale winning affiliate content using Spark Ads and GMV Max.

  • Analyze affiliate performance to determine which creators and assets should receive additional paid amplification.

TikTok Shop Management

  • Monitor TikTok Shop Seller Center performance and overall account health.

  • Ensure advertising strategies remain aligned with inventory availability, promotions, product performance, and shop activity.

  • Identify potential operational or performance issues that could impact campaign results.

Creative Testing & Optimization

  • Collaborate closely with creative teams to rapidly test hooks, concepts, transitions, formats, and TikTok-native trends.

  • Use performance data and AI-driven insights to guide creative iteration.

  • Identify winning assets quickly and translate performance learnings into actionable creative recommendations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of TikTok-native content and what drives users from discovery to purchase.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Analyze and report on ROAS, CAC, settled GMV, affiliate performance, and creative effectiveness.

  • Translate TikTok's attribution and commerce data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Use data to identify opportunities for additional growth and improved efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Paid Social Media Buying.

  • At least 1 year of specialized hands-on experience within the TikTok Shop ecosystem.

  • Proven experience managing $100K+ in monthly advertising spend, preferably for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

  • Advanced hands-on experience with:

    • TikTok Ads Manager

    • TikTok Shop Seller Center

    • TikTok Shop Affiliate Center

  • Strong understanding of Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, Live Shopping Ads, Spark Ads, and GMV Max.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and optimize campaigns based on GMV, ROAS, CAC, and other performance metrics.

  • Strong Google Sheets skills, including data analysis and modeling.

  • Experience working with TikTok Creative Center.

  • Strong understanding of performance creative and the ability to identify effective hooks, formats, and TikTok-native creative trends.

  • Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills.

  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment.

  • Ability to work PST or EST hours and participate in daily stand-ups and real-time campaign adjustments.

  • High-speed internet connection and a dedicated professional remote workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • TikTok Academy certifications in Media Buying and/or TikTok Shop.

  • Experience with Looker Studio.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative and video iteration tools such as CapCut, Symphony, or generative AI tools.

  • Experience with additional paid media platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Pinterest Ads, or Amazon Marketing Services (AMS).

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Data Science, Economics, or a related field.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be evaluated based on:

  • Total Shop GMV: Consistent month-over-month growth in settled TikTok Shop revenue.

  • Shop ROAS: Maintaining advertising efficiency above brand-specific profitability thresholds.

  • Affiliate Synergy: Increasing the percentage of revenue generated through successfully amplified affiliate content.

  • Creative Win Rate: Effectively identifying winning creative assets within the first 48–72 hours of testing.

  • Ability to translate performance data into actionable campaign and creative decisions.

  • Speed and effectiveness in adapting strategies as TikTok Shop trends, products, and campaign performance evolve.

Why Join Us

  • Work directly with high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands.

  • Manage meaningful advertising budgets and sophisticated TikTok Shop campaigns.

  • Develop expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of digital commerce.

  • Collaborate with experienced performance marketing, creative, and strategy professionals.

  • Work in an environment that values experimentation, data-driven decision-making, innovation, and speed.

  • Build strategies that directly influence revenue and measurable business growth.

Important Notes

  • This role is specifically focused on TikTok Shop and social commerce. Candidates should have direct, hands-on TikTok Shop experience rather than only general paid social experience.

  • Candidates must be comfortable working with significant advertising budgets and making performance-driven optimization decisions.

  • Full professional English proficiency is required due to the client-facing nature of the position.

  • Candidates must be available to work PST or EST hours.

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is expanding the engineering team behind the data foundation that powers our growing commercial organization. As a Senior Snowflake Platform Engineer, you will own the reliability, governance, security, and cost transparency of our Snowflake environment as the scale and importance of our data operations grow.

You will take a hands-on approach to platform engineering—solving production issues at their root, automating recurring work, strengthening controls, and building the monitoring and recovery capabilities that make the platform easier for others to operate. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Security, Identity, AWS, and commercial technology partners to ensure critical data is available, appropriately protected, and ready when the business needs it.

You will measure success by more than keeping Snowflake running. You will leave behind a platform that is increasingly reliable, observable, automated, cost-transparent, and supportable by the broader team—giving our engineers more capacity to build capabilities that ultimately support our mission for patients.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own Snowflake platform operations and health, including databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, tasks, procedures, and related services across development, test, and production environments. Maintain clear ownership and an accurate inventory of critical platform assets.
  • Strengthen platform security and governance by designing and automating role-based access, object ownership, grants, and access lifecycle controls. Partner with Identity and Security teams to maintain least-privilege access, effective identity integration, and timely access reviews and removal.
  • Drive platform reliability and proactively resolve issues across workloads, ingestion, dependencies, authentication, and data freshness. Perform root-cause analysis, implement durable solutions, and establish monitoring and alerts that identify issues before they affect users.
  • Build resilient and repeatable production support practices through actionable monitoring, runbooks, escalation paths, recovery procedures, and rollback capabilities. Participate in incident response, validate recovery approaches, and cross-train colleagues to eliminate single points of dependency.
  • Manage and optimize Snowflake consumption by establishing visibility into usage by workload and owner, identifying meaningful consumption trends, developing forecasts and thresholds, and optimizing warehouse configuration and high-cost workloads without compromising reliability or performance.
  • Automate and strengthen platform change management using version control, testing, peer review, automation, and controlled promotion across environments. Coordinate release readiness and regression testing across Snowflake, connected applications, vendor integrations, and AWS dependencies.
  • Create transparency and continuously improve the platform by reporting on reliability, access hygiene, consumption, and outstanding risks. Simplify unnecessary complexity, build reusable automation, maintain meaningful documentation, and thoughtfully apply AI to accelerate engineering while protecting data and production quality.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant experience across data platforms, cloud engineering, or data engineering—or equivalent demonstrated technical depth—with substantial hands-on experience operating Snowflake in production.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including experience automating operational work and investigating complex production failures.
  • Deep practical knowledge of Snowflake security and operations, including roles, grants, object ownership, warehouses, tasks, stored procedures, and operational telemetry.
  • Experience managing enterprise identities, service credentials, least-privilege access, and access lifecycle controls in partnership with Identity and Security teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand platform consumption, optimize workloads, and make thoughtful tradeoffs among cost, performance, and reliability.
  • Experience with Git-based development, peer review, automated testing, controlled releases, monitoring, incident response, and documented recovery procedures.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience.

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $35–$50 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is an applied AI internship inside a product where the model output is the product. We use LLMs to read unstructured professional histories, extract structure from them, score candidates against a role, and rank what a recruiter sees first. Every one of those steps can be confidently wrong, so the interesting work is as much about evaluating quality as it is about building the pipeline.

You will work on real LLM workflows against messy data at volume: designing prompts and extraction logic, building the evaluations that tell you whether a change actually helped, and improving ranking and retrieval where the current answer is not good enough. This is applied rather than research work, and you will be able to see the effect of what you build on what real users get.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve LLM workflows for extraction, scoring, and ranking against real product data.
  • Design evaluations that measure output quality, and use them to judge whether a change is an improvement.
  • Work with messy, high-volume unstructured data and turn it into reliable structure.
  • Improve retrieval and ranking so the most relevant results surface first.
  • Investigate incorrect or low-quality output and trace it back to its cause.

Requirements

  • Strong programming fundamentals in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or a similar language.
  • Interest in applied AI, machine learning, LLMs, ranking, retrieval, or data systems.
  • Comfort working with messy data and evaluating output quality.
  • Has built AI/ML, data, class, research, or side projects.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

jobs.excerpt: Das erwartet DichDein Hebel für die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen Bei Caspar Health arbeiten wir an der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen – digital, nachhaltig und ganzheitlich.
jobs.description:
Das erwartet Dich

Dein Hebel für die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen
Bei Caspar Health arbeiten wir an der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen – digital, nachhaltig und ganzheitlich. Unsere innovativen Lösungen verändern die medizinische Nachsorge und Prävention grundlegend. Um diesen Impact auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir eine strategisch starke und diplomatisch geschickte Persönlichkeit für unser Kernsegment.

Warum diese Rolle ein absoluter Gamechanger ist Vergiss den klassischen, starren Konzern-Strategen und das monotone Verwalten von Roadmaps. In dieser Rolle bist Du Macher*in und Intrapreneur zugleich: Du steuerst Dein Segment wie Dein eigenes Unternehmen im Unternehmen. Du bist die kommerzielle Speerspitze für unsere Software-Lösungen, um maximalen Markterfolg und echten, spürbaren Mehrwert im Leben von Patient:innen und Ärzt:innen zu stiften. Das ist kein seelenloses B2B-Dashboard – das ist Tech mit echtem Purpose und klarem Business-Impact.

Deine Rolle im Ökosystem & das Team-Set-Up Als Commercial Segment Lead übernimmst Du die unternehmerische End-to-End-Verantwortung für den kommerziellen Erfolg unserer Software-Lösungen. Da wir in einer agilen Matrix-Struktur arbeiten, steuerst Du das Segment horizontal: Du ziehst die Fäden als zentraler, cross-funktionaler Knotenpunkt zwischen Sales, Marketing und CSM zusammen. Du musst keine Code-Zeile verstehen und versinkst nicht im Tech-Deep-Dive – dafür steht Dir eine Product Commercial Managerin als dedizierte Übersetzungsschnittstelle und starker Gatekeeper zur Produktorganisation zur Seite. Deine Aufgabe beginnt dort, wo die Technik aufhört: Du machst aus Features echten Umsatz und nachhaltiges Wachstum.

Deine Herausforderungen

  • Strategische Segment-Steuerung: Definition der ganzheitlichen Segment-Strategie sowie Übernahme der vollen P&L-Verantwortung (ARR und Churn) zur Maximierung des kommerziellen Erfolgs
  • Go-to-Market-Ownership: Verantwortung für das strategische Positioning, Messaging, Pricing und Packaging auf Basis kontinuierlicher Markt-, Kunden- und Wettbewerbsanalysen
  • Datengestützte Priorisierung: Übersetzung der Bedarfe unserer B2B-Kunden in klare Business Cases sowie treffsichere, KPI-basierte Argumentation der Business-Anforderungen gegenüber der Produktorganisation
  • Feature-Storytelling & Sales Enablement: Strategische Einordnung von Produktentwicklungen sowie verständliche Formulierung und Verpackung des konkreten Mehrwerts für den Vertrieb und unsere Kunden
  • Cross-funktionale Orchestrierung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Marketing und CSM zur Erstellung hochwertiger, vertriebsrelevanter Assets und zur Steigerung der Win-Rate
  • Laterale Führung: Fachliche Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams und Zusammenziehen von Ressourcen aus den Fachabteilungen über exzellentes Stakeholder-Management

Dein Profil

  • B2B SaaS Commercial Background: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Product Marketing Management (PMM), im Business Development oder als Commercial Product Manager im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld mit. (Healthcare-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – wir geben Dir die Zeit für ein fundiertes Onboarding)
  • Nachweisbare P&L-Verantwortung: Du hast bereits erfolgreich Umsatz- und Budgetverantwortung getragen. Eine reine Roadmap- oder Feature-Verantwortung reicht für diese Rolle nicht aus – Du musst aktiv Umsatz und P&L gesteuert haben
  • Vertriebs- und Markt-Affinität: Du weißt genau, wie B2B-Vertriebszyklen funktionieren und wie man komplexe Software-Features in glasklare Value Propositions für den Vertrieb übersetzt
  • Analytische Steuerung: Sicherer Umgang mit Kern-KPIs (ARR, Churn, Net Retention) und die Fähigkeit, auch bei unvollständiger Datengrundlage im Scale-Up fundierte kommerzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Starke Matrix-Resilienz: Ausgeprägte Kompetenz im cross-funktionalen Management und die Fähigkeit, Teams ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis auf ein gemeinsames Ziel einzuschwören
  • Kommunikative Diplomatie: Psychologisch stabiles und souveränes Auftreten bei gegensätzlichen Stakeholder-Interessen (z. B. zwischen Sales und Produkt), gepaart mit hoher Pro-Aktivität und absoluter Verbindlichkeit

Warum Caspar Health?

  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – Office optional in Berlin Mitte oder 90 Tage im Jahr außerhalb Deutschlands
  • Passend dazu, unterstützen wir Dich mit einer monatlichen Homeoffice Pauschale und einem Essenszuschuss on Top
  • Genug Zeit zum erholen – mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr
  • Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen & Coaching, passend zu deinen Potentialen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung & Entscheidungsfreiheit: kein Mikromanagement – wir stellen Expert*innen ein, die wissen was sie tun #MakeAnImpact!
  • Echte Zusammenarbeit: keine Silos, keine Eitelkeiten – wir haben schließlich alle die gleiche Vision vor Augen #ValueFocus!
  • Zugang zu allen Caspar-Angeboten im Bereich mentale & physische Gesundheit #HealthyTogether!
  • Und ja – Alle Snack-Wünsche die das Herz begehrt, gemeinsame Sport-Sessions, ein nie endender Getränke Kühlschrank & eine gute Portion Humor gibt’s auch

Was uns als Team ausmacht

  • Wir leben Vielfalt – Diversität ist bei uns kein Aushängeschild, sondern Alltag
  • Feedback ist kein Tool, sondern Teil unserer Kultur
  • Wir glauben daran, dass Technologie nur dann sinnvoll ist, wenn sie Menschen hilft
  • Unser Antrieb ist Purpose – aber unser Anspruch ist Professionalität

jobs.description:
Lead Datacenter & Cloud Solution Architect

We are looking for a highly experienced Datacenter & Cloud Solution Architect to support a strategic infrastructure transformation initiative focused on defining the next-generation enterprise datacenter architecture, technology stack, and operating model.

The role requires a strong combination of hands-on infrastructure knowledge, enterprise architecture capability, and executive-level advisory skills. The successful candidate will help shape a future-state architecture that is technically sound, resilient, scalable, commercially supportable, and suitable for long-term business growth.

Role Overview

The architect will lead the technical assessment of the existing infrastructure landscape and translate business, operational, resilience, security, and technology requirements into a clear set of architecture principles and future-state recommendations.

A key part of the role is maintaining an independent and technology-neutral perspective while evaluating different infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, and managed-service options.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include:

  • Assessing the current datacenter and infrastructure environment
  • Identifying technology dependencies, constraints, lifecycle risks, and modernization opportunities
  • Defining future-state architecture principles and technical standards
  • Designing target architecture across:
    • Compute
    • Storage
    • Networking
    • Virtualization
    • Platform services
    • Backup and recovery
    • Disaster recovery
    • Monitoring
    • Automation
    • Infrastructure management
  • Evaluating alternative technology and architecture scenarios
  • Comparing different platforms and technology providers objectively
  • Assessing feasibility, complexity, compatibility, operational impact, lock-in, and strategic alignment
  • Developing technical decision frameworks and architecture comparison models
  • Assessing opportunities to reuse existing infrastructure and identifying refresh requirements
  • Defining high-level migration strategies, dependencies, sequencing, and major risks
  • Evaluating internal, hybrid, and managed operating models
  • Providing technical assumptions to support sizing, licensing, lifecycle, support, migration effort, and cost assessments
  • Supporting executive stakeholders with clear technical recommendations and decision materials

Expected Deliverables

The role may contribute to or own outputs such as:

  • Current-state infrastructure assessment
  • Architecture requirements and guiding principles
  • Future-state datacenter architecture
  • Technology option analysis
  • Feasibility and risk assessment
  • Architecture decision framework
  • Recommended technology stack
  • High-level migration roadmap
  • Compatibility and lifecycle assessment
  • Infrastructure sizing assumptions
  • Licensing and support assumptions
  • Migration and operational effort estimates
  • Hardware refresh assumptions
  • Technical inputs for Bill of Materials and cost modelling
  • Operating model considerations
  • Executive architecture recommendation
  • Technology selection documentation

The architect will provide the technical foundation for financial and commercial evaluations, while not being responsible for commercial negotiations or detailed financial modelling.

Cloud & Hybrid Architecture

Strong experience with Microsoft Azure is required, particularly across:

  • Landing zone architecture
  • Identity and security integration
  • Networking
  • Compute and storage
  • Governance and policy
  • Monitoring and observability
  • Hybrid connectivity
  • Cloud operating models
  • Cost optimization and FinOps considerations

Experience designing architectures that span on-premise, hybrid, and cloud environments is essential.

Infrastructure Expertise

Candidates should bring strong end-to-end knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, including areas such as:

  • Enterprise compute platforms
  • Storage architectures
  • Datacenter networking
  • VMware and/or Hyper-V environments
  • Enterprise backup and recovery platforms
  • Virtual Desktop Infrastructure
  • Windows and Linux environments
  • Database infrastructure
  • Monitoring and management platforms
  • Automation and orchestration
  • Disaster recovery and business continuity
  • Datacenter facilities and infrastructure dependencies

Transformation & Migration Experience

The ideal candidate will have previously supported large-scale infrastructure or cloud transformation programs involving complex environments, multiple systems, business units, or locations.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Datacenter consolidation or modernization
  • Cloud and hybrid-cloud migrations
  • Virtualization platform transformation
  • Infrastructure refresh programs
  • Application and workload migration planning
  • Operating model redesign
  • Managed-services transitions
  • Platform standardization
  • Infrastructure lifecycle modernization

The architect should be able to define migration waves, dependencies, technical sequencing, resource assumptions, risks, and validation requirements.

Architecture & Advisory Skills

The role requires the ability to operate effectively between senior management and deeply technical teams.

You should be comfortable facilitating workshops and working with stakeholders across:

  • Infrastructure
  • Network
  • Cybersecurity
  • Cloud
  • Operations
  • Architecture
  • Project and program management
  • Vendor management
  • Technology suppliers and service providers
  • Senior IT leadership

Strong written communication is essential, particularly the ability to produce concise and well-structured architecture reports, executive recommendations, and technical decision documents in English.

Vendor-Neutral Approach

A core requirement of the role is the ability to assess technologies independently and objectively.

Candidates should be comfortable evaluating competing architectures based on criteria such as:

  • Technical fit
  • Scalability
  • Resilience
  • Security
  • Compatibility
  • Operational complexity
  • Migration effort
  • Vendor dependency
  • Lifecycle considerations
  • Supportability
  • Strategic flexibility

Experience Profile

We are looking for a senior or lead-level architect with extensive experience in infrastructure, datacenter, cloud, systems management, or enterprise architecture.

A strong profile would typically include significant experience with complex enterprise environments and direct ownership of infrastructure architecture or transformation assessments.

Experience with large infrastructure estates, distributed operational environments, managed services, DevSecOps, FinOps, vendor orchestration, and operational governance will be particularly valuable.

Exposure to AI infrastructure readiness, accelerated computing, or emerging datacenter requirements associated with AI workloads would also be considered an advantage.

Engagement

This is a senior architecture advisory engagement requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgement, and the ability to translate complex infrastructure topics into clear recommendations for decision-makers.

Commercial terms will depend on experience, availability, and scope of responsibility.
